# Making the Medicines of Tomorrow

As a dedicated CDMO serving the healthcare industry, we bring life-enhancing and life-saving
treatments to market for our customers and their patients. We are a pioneer and world leader in the
CDMO industry, setting the pace with cutting-edge science, smart technology, and lean manufacturing.
United by a common purpose, we turn our customers’ breakthrough innovations into viable therapies
and manufacture the medicines of tomorrow.

Founded in Switzerland in 1897, our company is the first and original CDMO. Today, we bring together
a team of 20,000 colleagues across five continents to deliver integrated offerings that meet the
complex needs of our global customer community.

# Making the Medicines of Tomorrow

As a dedicated CDMO serving the healthcare industry, we bring life-enhancing and life-saving
treatments to market for our customers and their patients. We are a pioneer and world leader in the

and manufacture the medicines of tomorrow.

complex needs of our global customer community.

###### Science and a More Sustainable Future][246]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical and testing solutions and pharma specialty services,
serving the life sciences, applied and industrial, and food markets, today released its second
annual Sustainability Report, detailing the company's environmental, social, and governance
performance and progress in 2025.


###### [PerkinElmer and Covalent Announce Strategic Collaboration to Advance Failure Analysis and
###### Materials Characterization for Semiconductor, Electronics, and Battery Industries][247]

PerkinElmer and Covalent today announced a strategic collaboration to provide advanced analytical
instrumentation and analysis services that address the growing complexity of failure analysis and
materials characterization.


###### [PerkinElmer Partners with eXXpedition to Advance Ocean Science and a More Sustainable
###### Future][248]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical solutions that drive human and environmental health,
today announced a partnership with eXXpedition, the all-women global sailing research organization
dedicated to investigating the causes and impacts of plastic pollution in the marine environment.

###### Capital Project Complexity][249]

manufacturing for life-changing therapies, today announced a partnership with Oracle Primavera Cloud
(OPC) to enhance its project controls and capital program delivery capabilities for pharmaceutical
and biotech organizations.

Our strategy

curative medicines.

## A Trusted Partner of Life Science Research and the Biopharmaceutical Industry


We are living in the bio-century. Global medical knowledge is expanding at a rapid pace. But despite
huge breakthroughs, many diseases, such as cancer, rheumatism or Alzheimer's, are still not
curable.  Sartorius is part of the solution.

We help to ensure that new scientific discoveries can be translated more quickly into effective
patient care. With technologies, platforms and partnerships for a common goal: better health for
more people.

## A Trusted Partner of Life Science Research and the Biopharmaceutical Industry


We are living in the bio-century. Global medical knowledge is expanding at a rapid pace. But despite
huge breakthroughs, many diseases, such as cancer, rheumatism or Alzheimer's, are still not
curable.  Sartorius is part of the solution.

We help to ensure that new scientific discoveries can be translated more quickly into effective
patient care. With technologies, platforms and partnerships for a common goal: better health for
more people.

# Complete
# regenerative
# product line

5-Line Biologics offers a complete line of regenerative medical products from industry leading
manufacturers such as EmCyte and Tulip. We have many years of experience providing technical and
clinical support across multiple regenerative platforms. We are Veteran-owned, and we pride
ourselves on delivering value and service that is unmatched.

## 5-Line Carries The Highest Quality Biologics And Concentration Systems

We offer free shipping on all EmCyte products, no minimum order.

[PRP]

#### PRP

Product

Industry leading EmCyte PurePRP

[ Read More ][13]
[Adipose][Adipose]

Product

EmCyte PureBMC and Progenikine.  Tulip Cannulas.

[ Read More ][14]
[Medical Surgical][Medical Surgical]

#### Medical/Surgical Supplies

Product

We leverage 5-Line Medical’s large volume supply business to give discount med/surg supply pricing
to our regenerative medicine customers.

[ Read More ][15]
[Regulatory][Regulatory]

#### Regulatory

license

You may be purchasing a “Brand Name” device like EmCyte, but do you know anything about the dealer
you're buying it from.

[ Read More ][16]

#### Our Students

## Training

We offer in-person product training and follow-on support. All training and in-service can be
conducted in a fully virtual environment.

[ Schedule ][17]

#### Our Partners

## Manufacturer Partners

We partner with the top manufacturers in Regenerative medicine such as EmCyte and Tulip as well as
major medical and surgical supply manufacturers to bring you the absolute best products and value.

[ Explore More ][18]

#### 5 Line Biologics

If you are faced with choosing between multiple distributors representing many of the same top
manufacturers, then as both a consumer and a clinician, you should have two basic questions. First,
can they decrease my overall costs? Second, are their standards as high as mine?

[ Read More ][19]

#### Our Approach

We understand how complex and confusing the regenerative medicine space can be.

[ Read More ][20]

Whether you’re brand new to Regenerative Medicine or have been here for years, we can help.

[ Get In Touch ][21]

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Here are some great questions you have on your mind!

Does a distributor need to be registered with the state of NJ to sell medical devices there?

Yes. [NJAC 8:21-3A][22] is the applicable statute. You can verify a distribution
business [here][23]. Our registration number is 5005403.

Does my practice require a blood bank license to prepare PRP?

Yes. Under the provisions of [NJSA 26:2A][24] you will be required to obtain a blood bank license
for perioperative autologous blood collection/administration. It is a fairly easy process and we are
happy to help guide you through this.

Please call us at [609-975-9884][25] or send an e-mail to [info@5linemed.com][26] to request more
information.

[[5 line Biologics logo][5 line Biologics logo]][27]

We provide full in-service product support. We also offer one-on-one training conducted through
partner physicians experienced with these types of procedures. We will provide this training in your
office.

5-Line Biologics offers a complete line of regenerative medical products from industry leading
manufacturers such as EmCyte and Tulip. We have many years of experience providing technical and
clinical support across multiple regenerative platforms. We are Veteran-owned, and we pride
ourselves on delivering value and service that is unmatched.

## Training

We offer in-person product training and follow-on support. All training and in-service can be
conducted in a fully virtual environment.

[ Schedule ][17]

#### Our Partners

## Manufacturer Partners

We partner with the top manufacturers in Regenerative medicine such as EmCyte and Tulip as well as
major medical and surgical supply manufacturers to bring you the absolute best products and value.

[ Explore More ][18]

#### 5 Line Biologics

If you are faced with choosing between multiple distributors representing many of the same top
manufacturers, then as both a consumer and a clinician, you should have two basic questions. First,
can they decrease my overall costs? Second, are their standards as high as mine?

[ Read More ][19]

#### Our Approach

We understand how complex and confusing the regenerative medicine space can be.

[ Read More ][20]

Whether you’re brand new to Regenerative Medicine or have been here for years, we can help.

[ Get In Touch ][21]

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Here are some great questions you have on your mind!

Does a distributor need to be registered with the state of NJ to sell medical devices there?

Yes. [NJAC 8:21-3A][22] is the applicable statute. You can verify a distribution
business [here][23]. Our registration number is 5005403.

Does my practice require a blood bank license to prepare PRP?

Yes. Under the provisions of [NJSA 26:2A][24] you will be required to obtain a blood bank license
for perioperative autologous blood collection/administration. It is a fairly easy process and we are
happy to help guide you through this.

Please call us at [609-975-9884][25] or send an e-mail to [info@5linemed.com][26] to request more
information.

[[5 line Biologics logo][5 line Biologics logo]][27]

We provide full in-service product support. We also offer one-on-one training conducted through
partner physicians experienced with these types of procedures. We will provide this training in your
office.

## Explore Our Products
* [
  Primary Cells
  
  Primary cells are isolated from fresh tissues, which can maintain the basic properties of the
  original cells. Therefore, as an in vitro experimental model, primary cells are widely used in
  basic research of molecular, cell biology and biomedicine, such as proteomics, genomics and
  genetics, and also in drug screening, drug metabolism and toxicology, cancer drug research, etc.
  AcceGen provides 1,278 kinds of primary cells from human and animals, including human primary
  cells from motor system, nervous system, endocrine system, digestive system, blood system, urinary
  system, reproductive system, immune system, respiratory system, and PBMCs; and animal primary
  cells from mouse, rat, bovine, monkey, rabbit, porcine, chicken, dog, cat, and horse.
  
  Explore More
  ][167]
* [
  Tumor Cell Lines
  
  Tumor cell lines, also called Cancer cell lines, are an important part of tumors, they are the
  main component of tumors and tissue specific. Cancer cells have three important basic
  characteristics: immortality, migration, and loss of contact inhibition. In addition, carcinoma
  cells have many physiological, biochemical, and morphological characteristics that are different
  from normal cells. Different cancer cell lines provide a wide range of experimental materials for
  studying the occurrence and development of tumors and have played an important role in the
  in-depth study of tumor immunotherapy, tumor-targeted therapy, and tumor resistance.
  
  Explore More
  ][168]
* [
  Transfected Stable Cell Lines
  
  Transfected Stable Cell Lines is an important research tool for pharmaceutical drug discovery,
  compound screening, and gene therapy research. The transfected stable cell lines are constructed
  by integrating the exogenous plasmid DNA into the host cell chromosome so that the host cell can
  express the protein of interest for a long period of time. Key Features of AcceGen Transfected
  Stable Cell Lines: ● The exogenous fragment can be stably expressed in dividing cells for a long
  time (> 2 weeks). ● Establishing stable cell lines can help screen appropriate number of cells for
  experimental research. ● By establishing stable cell lines, the cost of excessive conversion of
  dyes or virus packaging can be greatly reduced, and experimental research is greatly facilitated.
  ● Establishing stable cell lines can achieve better genetic interference effects. ● It can
  effectively eliminate the interference of individual differences (the same type of cells,
  different individual cell genomes) on the experimental results. AcceGen is committed to providing
  ready-to-go stable cell lines and knockout cell lysate for your basic research. Use the Mutant
  Gene Nomenclature to search, if you cannot find the specific product in our database, AcceGen
  Custom Stable Cell Lines Service is committed to pave new ways to meet all your needs.
  
  Explore More
  ][169]
* [
  Immortalized Cell Lines
  
  After the primary cells experience limited population proliferation during the culture process,
  the primary cells cease to proliferate. Immortalized cells are derived from primary cells:
  exogenous immortalized genes (EBV, HPV E6 / 7 and SV40 T antigens of recombinant lentivirus,
  retrovirus & adenovirus, hTERT, p53) are introduced into target cells by gene transfection
  technology and immortalized cell lines are established to achieve cell culture in vitro so that
  cells cultured in vitro have the ability to proliferate and there is no difference between cells.
  Through immortalization, those cells that are difficult to pass down, slow to proliferate, and
  easy to age can be immortalized, thereby providing researchers with more cell resources and
  providing a good in vitro cell model for scientific research. AcceGen has about 60 kinds of
  immortalised cell lines, including human immortalised cells, mouse immortalised cells, and rat
  immortalised cells. AcceGen also provides Custom Cell Immortalization Service for your unique
  solutions.
  
  Explore More
  ][170]
* [
  Stem Cells
  
  Stem Cells, also calls Progenitor Cells, are a kind of self-replicating pluripotent cells, which
  can differentiate into multiple functional cells under certain conditions. Given this
  characteristic, some diseases can be cured by transplanting stem cells or related derivatives into
  patients to replace damaged cells. Stem cells have become the frontier and hotspot of life science
  and medical research at the beginning of this century because of the broad application prospects
  in the fields of disease treatment and regenerative medicine.
  
  Explore More
  ][171]
* [
  MicroRNA Agomir/Antagomir
  
  MicroRNA (miRNA) is a type of endogenous small RNA with a length of about 20-24 nucleotides. A
  combination of several miRNAs can be used to fine-tune the expression of a gene. MicroRNA Agomir
  is a special-labeled and chemically modified double-stranded small RNA that mimics the endogenous
  miRNA to regulate the biological function of the target gene. MicroRNA Antagomir is an especially
  chemically modified miRNA antagonist. It strongly competes with mature miRNAs in the body to
  prevent the complementary pairing of miRNAs and their target genes, thereby inhibiting miRNAs from
  functioning. NOMENCLATURE 1. The miRNA mature body is abbreviated as miR, and then according to
  its species name, such as the human being abbreviated as hsa, and the order in which it was found
  is represented by Arabic numerals, such as hsa-miR-122. 2. Highly homologous miRNAs are followed
  by lowercase letters (a, b, c, ...), such as hsa-miR-34a, hsa-miR-34b, hsa-miR-34c, and so on. 3.

  AcceGen provides 1,278 kinds of primary cells from human and animals, including human primary
  cells from motor system, nervous system, endocrine system, digestive system, blood system, urinary
  system, reproductive system, immune system, respiratory system, and PBMCs; and animal primary
  cells from mouse, rat, bovine, monkey, rabbit, porcine, chicken, dog, cat, and horse.
  
  Explore More
  ][167]
* [
  Tumor Cell Lines
  
  Tumor cell lines, also called Cancer cell lines, are an important part of tumors, they are the
  main component of tumors and tissue specific. Cancer cells have three important basic
  characteristics: immortality, migration, and loss of contact inhibition. In addition, carcinoma
  cells have many physiological, biochemical, and morphological characteristics that are different
  from normal cells. Different cancer cell lines provide a wide range of experimental materials for
  studying the occurrence and development of tumors and have played an important role in the
  in-depth study of tumor immunotherapy, tumor-targeted therapy, and tumor resistance.
  
  Explore More
  ][168]
* [
  Transfected Stable Cell Lines
  
  Transfected Stable Cell Lines is an important research tool for pharmaceutical drug discovery,
  compound screening, and gene therapy research. The transfected stable cell lines are constructed
  by integrating the exogenous plasmid DNA into the host cell chromosome so that the host cell can
  express the protein of interest for a long period of time. Key Features of AcceGen Transfected
  Stable Cell Lines: ● The exogenous fragment can be stably expressed in dividing cells for a long
  time (> 2 weeks). ● Establishing stable cell lines can help screen appropriate number of cells for
  experimental research. ● By establishing stable cell lines, the cost of excessive conversion of
  dyes or virus packaging can be greatly reduced, and experimental research is greatly facilitated.
  ● Establishing stable cell lines can achieve better genetic interference effects. ● It can
  effectively eliminate the interference of individual differences (the same type of cells,
  different individual cell genomes) on the experimental results. AcceGen is committed to providing
  ready-to-go stable cell lines and knockout cell lysate for your basic research. Use the Mutant
  Gene Nomenclature to search, if you cannot find the specific product in our database, AcceGen
  Custom Stable Cell Lines Service is committed to pave new ways to meet all your needs.
  
  Explore More
  ][169]
* [
  Immortalized Cell Lines
  
  After the primary cells experience limited population proliferation during the culture process,
  the primary cells cease to proliferate. Immortalized cells are derived from primary cells:
  exogenous immortalized genes (EBV, HPV E6 / 7 and SV40 T antigens of recombinant lentivirus,
  retrovirus & adenovirus, hTERT, p53) are introduced into target cells by gene transfection
  technology and immortalized cell lines are established to achieve cell culture in vitro so that
  cells cultured in vitro have the ability to proliferate and there is no difference between cells.
  Through immortalization, those cells that are difficult to pass down, slow to proliferate, and
  easy to age can be immortalized, thereby providing researchers with more cell resources and
  providing a good in vitro cell model for scientific research. AcceGen has about 60 kinds of
  immortalised cell lines, including human immortalised cells, mouse immortalised cells, and rat
  immortalised cells. AcceGen also provides Custom Cell Immortalization Service for your unique
  solutions.
  
  Explore More
  ][170]
* [
  Stem Cells
  
  Stem Cells, also calls Progenitor Cells, are a kind of self-replicating pluripotent cells, which
  can differentiate into multiple functional cells under certain conditions. Given this
  characteristic, some diseases can be cured by transplanting stem cells or related derivatives into
  patients to replace damaged cells. Stem cells have become the frontier and hotspot of life science
  and medical research at the beginning of this century because of the broad application prospects
  in the fields of disease treatment and regenerative medicine.
  
  Explore More
  ][171]
* [
  MicroRNA Agomir/Antagomir
  
  MicroRNA (miRNA) is a type of endogenous small RNA with a length of about 20-24 nucleotides. A
  combination of several miRNAs can be used to fine-tune the expression of a gene. MicroRNA Agomir
  is a special-labeled and chemically modified double-stranded small RNA that mimics the endogenous
  miRNA to regulate the biological function of the target gene. MicroRNA Antagomir is an especially
  chemically modified miRNA antagonist. It strongly competes with mature miRNAs in the body to
  prevent the complementary pairing of miRNAs and their target genes, thereby inhibiting miRNAs from
  functioning. NOMENCLATURE 1. The miRNA mature body is abbreviated as miR, and then according to
  its species name, such as the human being abbreviated as hsa, and the order in which it was found
  is represented by Arabic numerals, such as hsa-miR-122. 2. Highly homologous miRNAs are followed
  by lowercase letters (a, b, c, ...), such as hsa-miR-34a, hsa-miR-34b, hsa-miR-34c, and so on. 3.

### Culturing Innovative Partnerships

###### ADVENT BIOSERVICES


###### CONTRACT DEVELOPMENT & MANUFACTURING ORGANISATION (CDMO)

#### Your ideal partner in cell therapy

Advent Bioservices began activity as a cell therapy Contract Development & Manufacturing
Organisation (CDMO) in 2016. We are currently managing the development of a state-of-the-art
facility for multiproduct Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) production outside Sawston in
Cambridgeshire, which will allow scale up of current commercial production and initiate the
provision of contract manufacturing services to meet the growing demand for such services in the
UK. 

 

The Sawston facility is perfectly positioned in the ‘UK golden triangle’ for cell and gene therapy,
our facility is located just 7 miles outside Cambridge city centre with excellent transport links to
Central London, London Stansted airport and it is 4 miles from the M11 motorway, linking to the
Midlands by the new A14 extension.

 

The facility consists of 2 separate GMP suites with grade B/C classified areas, in house QC testing,
process development laboratories, warehouse and office space as well as a multipurpose cold storage
and cryogenic storage unit. 

 

We operate the facility under a comprehensive IT infrastructure including EMS,  eQMS eBMR and LIMS
systems with secure storage for client documents and paperless systems. Our cleanroom suites are
fully validated, with an in-house environmental monitoring system. Clients utilising our
manufacturing service will benefit from ancillary services and technical support inclusive of
process development, QC and validation. Ultra-cold and cryogenic facilities are available to
external clients as off-site storage and are fully GMP compliant.

.

About Us
Why Choose Us?

## Why Choose Us?

Important values we share with our partners...

[Scalability.png]

#### SCALABILITY

We can help you solve your scale up difficulties and can support your expansion across multiple
areas including research and development,  process development, higher volume manufacturing and
meeting regulatory standards.

[Boundaries.png]

#### EXPANDED

#### POTENTIAL

We can develop to meet your need, wherever they are. With our global mindset, Advent Bioservices can
break down borders ensuring the best possible outcome at every stage of your journey.

[Benchmarks.png]

#### REGULATORY COMPLIANCE

We operate to the highest industry standards with expertise in regulatory standards including HTA,
MHRA and JACIE. We are GMP and GLP compliant and strive to reach the best quality output. We are
here to help you ensure that your process complies with relevant standards.

[HumanTouch.png]

#### THE PERSONAL TOUCH

The Advent Bioservices team is conscientious, professional and easy to communicate with. We nurture
our business with respect for our clients needs. We have a happy and healthy business culture.

[Discovery.png]

#### DISCOVERY

Research and development plays a vital part in the advancement of the growth of the cell and gene
therapies industry. We can help you by focusing on innovation and optimisation, attending to your
individual requirements.

[HealthPartners.png]

#### CULTURING PARTNERSHIPS

In the complex biosciences industry, having people that you trust is essential. Our priorities are
focused on building long-term partnerships and supporting our clients.

## Some positive words

#### “Coming to work knowing we are contributing to improving another person’s quality of life is
#### unbelievably rewarding. On top of that coming to a company who offer tremendous opportunities
#### for both professional and personal development is just wonderful”

- Alia Klyn. Production Scientist.

Services & Facilites

## Services & Facilities

The UK cell and gene therapy industry is expanding at a rapid rate. In the last 5 years, cleanroom
space increased annually to a current total of 7819 sq m and the UK initiated 112 new ATMP clinical
trials - the highest number for all European countries. This has resulted in strong demand for GMP
manufacturing services, expertise in commercialisation and scale up of manufacture.

 

See what Advent BioService has to offer below.

###### CONTRACT DEVELOPMENT & MANUFACTURING ORGANISATION (CDMO)

#### Your ideal partner in cell therapy

Advent Bioservices began activity as a cell therapy Contract Development & Manufacturing
Organisation (CDMO) in 2016. We are currently managing the development of a state-of-the-art
facility for multiproduct Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) production outside Sawston in
Cambridgeshire, which will allow scale up of current commercial production and initiate the
provision of contract manufacturing services to meet the growing demand for such services in the
UK. 

 

The Sawston facility is perfectly positioned in the ‘UK golden triangle’ for cell and gene therapy,
our facility is located just 7 miles outside Cambridge city centre with excellent transport links to
Central London, London Stansted airport and it is 4 miles from the M11 motorway, linking to the
Midlands by the new A14 extension.

 

The facility consists of 2 separate GMP suites with grade B/C classified areas, in house QC testing,
process development laboratories, warehouse and office space as well as a multipurpose cold storage
and cryogenic storage unit. 

 

We operate the facility under a comprehensive IT infrastructure including EMS,  eQMS eBMR and LIMS
systems with secure storage for client documents and paperless systems. Our cleanroom suites are
fully validated, with an in-house environmental monitoring system. Clients utilising our
manufacturing service will benefit from ancillary services and technical support inclusive of
process development, QC and validation. Ultra-cold and cryogenic facilities are available to
external clients as off-site storage and are fully GMP compliant.

[See our entire journey][139]
1907
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey beginning in 1907]

Started manufacturing tinctures and alcohol at Vadodara

1940
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1940]

Began production of cough syrups, vitamins, tonics and sulphur drugs

1961
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1961]

Inaugurated Penicilin plant with Lal Bahadur Shastri in attendance

1967
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1967]

Initiated bulk manufacturing of Vitamin B12

1971
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1971]

Manufactured Erythromycin for the first time in Indian history

1972
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1972]

Launched Althrocin, a brand of Erythromycin

1997
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1997]

Althrocin moves to become top selling brand in India

1999
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1999]

Kickstarted the production of synthetic, organic API

2000
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2000]

Received ISO 14000 certification for facilities at Vadodara

2001
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2001]

Began production of Cephalosporin C

2007
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2007]

Acquired non-oncology business of M/s Dabur Pharma Ltd.

2009
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2009]

Addressed chronic therapies through multiple marketing divisions

2011
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2011]

Demerged from Alembic group to form Alembic Pharmaceutical Ltd, and gets listed

2012
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2012]

Unveiled the Dematology division in domestic market with 8 products

2013
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2013]

Started first NDA with a partner and commenced filing in EU, Australia and Brazil

2015
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2015]

Launched Aripiprazole and established the US Front-end as also transitioning to in-house marketing
in the US

2016
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2016]

Struck a JV with Orbicular – Aleor Dermaceutical Limited to develop dermatology products for the
international market

2017

[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Inaugurated the manufacturing facility for Oncology medicines, including oral solids and liquid
injectable vials, in the presence of the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Gujarat, Shri. Vijay Rupani

2017
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Acquired Orit Laboratories LLC, USA

2018
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2018]

Received FDA approvals for Aleor’s dermatology facility

2019
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2019]

Granted approvals for Oncology oral solid facility

Entered a JV to foray into the China market

2020
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2020]

Achieved the milestone of US$ 250 million sales in the US frontend

At the service of society

We are dedicated to creating more sustainable solutions and resilient communities.

Energy Security Framework Gas Prices Explained Permitting Reform American Energy Snapshot

### **AMERICAN ENERGY SECURITY FRAMEWORK**

Recent geopolitical disruptions and their impact on global energy markets have been a stark reminder
that energy security remains inseparable from economic security and geopolitical stability. The
United States is better positioned than most nations to navigate market volatility, thanks to
decades of investment and innovation that made America the world's leading producer of oil and
natural gas and a reliable supplier to global markets. But future disruptions will require a
stronger, more flexible energy system—one built on secure supply, modern infrastructure and
resilience.

The following recommendations provide a framework for getting there.

SECURE AMERICAN ENERGY SUPPLY
* Develop a Robust Federal Offshore Leasing Program
* Ensure Stable, Consistent Fuel Supply Through a Functional Renewable Fuel Standard
* Optimize the Strategic Petroleum Reserve

BUILD INFRASTRUCTURE AND MOVE ENERGY
* Pass Comprehensive Permitting Reform
* Improve the Jones Act to Unlock Domestic Energy Flexibility
* Provide Relief from Unnecessary Tariffs on Critical Energy Inputs

STRENGTHEN RESILIENCE AND SUPPLY CHAINS
* Work with Persian Gulf Allies to Reduce Reliance on the Strait of Hormuz
* Strengthen Western Hemisphere Energy Security

### **AMERICAN ENERGY SECURITY FRAMEWORK**

Recent geopolitical disruptions and their impact on global energy markets have been a stark reminder
that energy security remains inseparable from economic security and geopolitical stability. The
United States is better positioned than most nations to navigate market volatility, thanks to
decades of investment and innovation that made America the world's leading producer of oil and
natural gas and a reliable supplier to global markets. But future disruptions will require a
stronger, more flexible energy system—one built on secure supply, modern infrastructure and
resilience.

The following recommendations provide a framework for getting there.

SECURE AMERICAN ENERGY SUPPLY
* Develop a Robust Federal Offshore Leasing Program
* Ensure Stable, Consistent Fuel Supply Through a Functional Renewable Fuel Standard
* Optimize the Strategic Petroleum Reserve

BUILD INFRASTRUCTURE AND MOVE ENERGY

* Improve the Jones Act to Unlock Domestic Energy Flexibility
* Provide Relief from Unnecessary Tariffs on Critical Energy Inputs

# A Focus on...

Join the American Society of Gene & Cell Therapy to connect with a global community dedicated to
advancing genetic and cellular therapies to alleviate human disease.

[ Join ASGCT ][151] [ About Us ][152]

## Advancing Knowledge, Awareness, and Education of Cell and Gene Therapies

Discover upcoming events and opportunities to advance your knowledge, build connections, and propel
the field forward.

### Introducing the ASGCT Foundation

This charitable nonprofit is dedicated to ensuring that the life-changing potential of gene and cell
therapy reaches every patient.

[ Learn More ][153]

### GME Bootcamp

This focused, one-day bootcamp is designed to prepare the next generation of clinicians to safely
and effectively integrate cell and gene therapies into patient care.

[ Join Us August 21 ][154]

### Policy Summit

Collaborate on innovative solutions with your colleagues at this dynamic, one-day event on September
14 in Washington, D.C.

[ Details ][155]

[ Join Us August 21 ][157]

### Policy Summit

Collaborate on innovative solutions with your colleagues at this dynamic, one-day event on September
14 in Washington, D.C.

[ Details ][158]

## At the Forefront of the Cell and Gene Therapy Industry

Become a part of the largest and most inclusive cell and gene therapy community, including top
researchers and clinicians from academia and bio-industry working alongside patients, families, and
advocates.

### CGTxchange

We've partnered with the Orphan Therapeutics Accelerator to create a dedicated clearinghouse and
marketplace designed to catalyze the development of cell and gene therapies that have been shelved
due to economic or strategic shifts.

[ Explore Now ][159]
Podcasts

### ASGCT Podcast Network

Find insightful interviews, riveting conversations, and incredible discoveries on the ASGCT Podcast
Network. Listen to the latest episodes of the Molecular Therapy Podcast, Giants of Gene Therapy, and
The Issue.

[ Listen ][160]
Collaborations

### Partner with ASGCT

ASGCT offers year-round advertising, sponsorship, and talent recruitment opportunities to help you
meet your marketing and strategic goals.

[ Get Started ][161]

### ASGCT Foundation

The ASGCT Foundation is a charitable nonprofit organization dedicated to ensuring that the
life-changing potential of gene and cell therapy reaches every patient. By addressing resource
scarcity and systemic barriers, the Foundation works to bridge the gap between scientific discovery
and patient delivery. 

[ Learn More ][162]

## Developing best practice in cell therapy manufacturing

#### #### The amc (Advanced therapy medicinal products Manufacturing Community) was formed in
#### #### September 2010 for the emerging cell therapy industry. Whilst the UK is excellent in
#### #### scientific development of cell therapies, robust manufacturing processes, essential to
#### #### establishing industry, now need to be developed.
#### 
#### #### Our vision is that the whole ATMP Manufacturing Community is the team. Members are
#### #### encouraged to attend, speak and facilitate our meetings, as well as being proactive in our
#### #### online presence.

[Members Login][19]

### The amc aims to build a critical mass that will;
* Share non commercial information so that members can learn from the experience of others
* Develop best practice to reduce the barriers to advanced therapy manufacture
* Inform and influence regulators and suppliers through a single consistent voice representing the
  industry
* Showcase UK GMP capacity to make it easy for developers (national and international) to find a
  facility which best meets their demands

We have around **[400 members][20]** who represent advanced manufacturing facilities and processes
in academia and industry. We share ideas and discuss solutions in our bi-annual technical meetings
and our Linkedin forum.

If you are active in ATMP manufacture and would like to **[join our community][21]** we always
welcome new members.

in academia and industry. We share ideas and discuss solutions in our bi-annual technical meetings
and our Linkedin forum.

If you are active in ATMP manufacture and would like to **[join our community][21]** we always
welcome new members.

## Join the Community…

## We always welcome new members.

#### The amc was formed in September 2010 for the emerging cell therapy industry. Whilst the UK is
#### excellent in scientific development of cell therapies, robust manufacturing processes,
#### essential to establishing industry, now need to be developed.

The AI Scientist connects predictive models, structured data, and wet lab execution into a single

structured data, and recommends the next step — so every experiment compounds on the last.

Plan, record, and share experiments using a collaborative, cloud-based notebook.

Cut manual and repetitive work with automated workflows and analytics.

Use AI tools to work more efficiently.

Model and track scientific data for biomolecules, small molecules, cell lines, animals, reagents,
and more.

Design a unified data model across experiments to power computational science.

Access out-of-the-box integrations, build custom apps, and connect data from instruments, software,
and beyond.

Scale on a secure, flexible platform that adapts to your science and ecosystem.

structured data, and recommends the next step — so every experiment compounds on the last.

and more.

### Cell and gene supply chain

guaranteeing a flawless chain of custody for all cell and gene therapy logistics solutions.

challenge with decades of experience and innovation.

Outstanding care, knowledge and attention throughout every stage of the pharmaceutical supply chain,

### Cryogenic transportation

Our cryogenic transport solutions ensure safe, compliant delivery of temperature-sensitive
biological materials worldwide.

][93] [

### Laboratory logistics

We offer tailored lab logistics for life sciences, ensuring compliant, temperature-controlled
transport of samples, reagents, and devices for efficient global operations.

][94]

### Case studyDelivering personalized supply chains for autologous cell therapies

The customer develops cell therapy platforms for a variety of solid tumors. Biocair was contacted to
collect and transport the cells to the manufacturing site in Europe, and then ship them back to the
patients in the US.

[More information][95]

### WhitepaperThe challenges of cell and gene logistics

The cell and gene therapy sector relies upon an advanced supply chain that must consistently perform
to the highest clinical standards.

[Read now][96]

### Case studyBringing innovation to clinical trial supply chains

Increasingly complex and global clinical trials have led drug developers to collaborate with
logistics experts to manage their clinical trials supply chain.

[Read now][97]

### WhitepaperTransforming the personalized medicine supply chain

Biocair takes a look at this rapidly expanding area and explores the vital role a logistics expert
can play in supporting it.

[Download now][98]

[Decorative hexagons - top]

 

 

[Decorative hexagons - top]

## Experts in temperature-controlled shipping

From the moment your consignment leaves, you need to know it is in the hands of experts who can
deliver reliable temperature-controlled shipping.

We know that flawless execution is essential in every aspect of logistics. From choosing the most
efficient transport route, to evaluating, validating and implementing the most appropriate
packaging, Biocair understands that effective logistics solutions are absolutely vital to maintain
the integrity of your precious materials.

With Biocair, it’s never just about moving a shipment from A to B — it’s about **building logistics
around your needs**. Every shipment represents months of work, critical research, and ultimately,
patient lives. That’s why our global experts take a proactive, flexible, and accountable approach at
every stage — anticipating risks, navigating complex regulations, and adapting to changing
conditions to ensure your materials arrive exactly as intended, every time.

[Decorative hexagons - top]

 

 

[Decorative hexagons - top]

### From innovation to impact: unlocking patient access to innovative rare disease medicines

The BIA’s latest report reveals that despite the UK’s strong rare disease research base, patients
still face fragmented and unpredictable access to life-changing treatments.

[Read the report][89]

[ [RDIG report.png 1] ][90]

### UK TechBio goes mainstream

The latest BIA report, TechBio: Future-ready biology, shows that TechBio now accounts for 40% of all
UK biotech deals, securing over £2.6 billion in capital between 2020–2024. Landmark deals from
Recursion, Isomorphic Labs, and CHARM Therapeutics underscore the sector’s maturity and world-class
value. While celebrating the UK’s strong early-stage innovation, the report also highlights the
“scale-up gap” as the next strategic challenge for the sector.

[Read the full report][91]

[TechBio 2025 report website banner new.png]

### Updated for 2025! mRNA Revolution: A new generation of medicine

The UK life sciences sector is leading a new era of innovation, with mRNA at its heart. Our updated
mRNA Revolution explainer highlights how the UK has moved from promise to delivery, attracting
global leaders like Moderna and BioNTech, investing in infrastructure like the RNA Biofoundry and
closing skills gaps through initiatives like ATAC.

[Read the report][92]

[ [mRNA explainer 2025 video promo.png] ][93]

### PULSE: Empowering the future of UK biotech

We’re excited to share the latest edition of our report, featuring two new case studies that
highlight the impact of PULSE in driving biotech innovation across the UK. This edition spotlights
two pioneering spinouts – MarraBio and ConsoneAI – which have successfully secured funding to
advance their groundbreaking research.

[Discover new case studies][94]

[ [PULSE new case studies v2.png] ][95]

### Functional genomics explainer: a unique opportunity for the UK

Functional genomics is a vital field in delivering the promise of precision medicine. By moving
beyond genome sequencing to understand how genetic variation shapes biological function, this area
is unlocking new possibilities for targeted treatments and improved patient outcomes.

[Learn more][96]

[Functional Genomics (landscape.png]

### Vision 2035: Shaping the future of UK life sciences

After 18 months of in-depth research and consultation with members and industry leaders, we’re proud
to share our 10-Year Vision for the UK life sciences sector. Vision 2035 outlines a bold roadmap for
building a stronger, more resilient biotech ecosystem—one with a robust long-term capital base that
supports both early and later-stage companies. To turn this vision into reality, we must
collectively focus on the areas with the greatest potential for impact.

[Discover our Vision for UK life sciences in 2035][97]

[Read the report][89]

[ [RDIG report.png 1] ][90]

### UK TechBio goes mainstream

The latest BIA report, TechBio: Future-ready biology, shows that TechBio now accounts for 40% of all
UK biotech deals, securing over £2.6 billion in capital between 2020–2024. Landmark deals from
Recursion, Isomorphic Labs, and CHARM Therapeutics underscore the sector’s maturity and world-class
value. While celebrating the UK’s strong early-stage innovation, the report also highlights the
“scale-up gap” as the next strategic challenge for the sector.

[Read the full report][91]

[TechBio 2025 report website banner new.png]

### Updated for 2025! mRNA Revolution: A new generation of medicine

The UK life sciences sector is leading a new era of innovation, with mRNA at its heart. Our updated
mRNA Revolution explainer highlights how the UK has moved from promise to delivery, attracting
global leaders like Moderna and BioNTech, investing in infrastructure like the RNA Biofoundry and
closing skills gaps through initiatives like ATAC.

[Read the report][92]

[ [mRNA explainer 2025 video promo.png] ][93]

### PULSE: Empowering the future of UK biotech

We’re excited to share the latest edition of our report, featuring two new case studies that
highlight the impact of PULSE in driving biotech innovation across the UK. This edition spotlights
two pioneering spinouts – MarraBio and ConsoneAI – which have successfully secured funding to
advance their groundbreaking research.

[Discover new case studies][94]

[ [PULSE new case studies v2.png] ][95]

### Functional genomics explainer: a unique opportunity for the UK

Functional genomics is a vital field in delivering the promise of precision medicine. By moving
beyond genome sequencing to understand how genetic variation shapes biological function, this area
is unlocking new possibilities for targeted treatments and improved patient outcomes.

[Learn more][96]

[Functional Genomics (landscape.png]

### Vision 2035: Shaping the future of UK life sciences

After 18 months of in-depth research and consultation with members and industry leaders, we’re proud
to share our 10-Year Vision for the UK life sciences sector. Vision 2035 outlines a bold roadmap for
building a stronger, more resilient biotech ecosystem—one with a robust long-term capital base that
supports both early and later-stage companies. To turn this vision into reality, we must
collectively focus on the areas with the greatest potential for impact.

[Discover our Vision for UK life sciences in 2035][97]

# We believe the promise of cell and gene therapies starts with the integrity of a single cell

Advancing the future of cell and gene therapy

The human body can heal itself. Cell and gene therapies are designed to augment the patient’s
ability to fight disease but only if the living cells behind those therapies remain viable and
functional throughout the production processes. At **BioLife Solutions**, our mission is to protect
the integrity of cells and provide trusted tools, services, and expertise that can enable our
customers to advance the development and delivery of cell and gene therapies. We believe the future
of cell and gene therapies hinges on the integrity of every single cell and we are here to protect
that promise.

We understand the technical demands of bioprocessing in this field, and our advanced biopreservation
expertise, cell culture optimization products, innovative storage systems, and closed-system
manufacturing solutions are designed to enhance process efficiency, maintain cellular viability, and
ensure reproducibility at every stage. Whether scaling up from R&D, navigating clinical trials or
optimizing cryopreservation protocols for commercial production, we provide the tools and experience
to streamline your workflow and safeguard your therapies.

# We believe the promise of cell and gene therapies starts with the integrity of a single cell

Advancing the future of cell and gene therapy

The human body can heal itself. Cell and gene therapies are designed to augment the patient’s
ability to fight disease but only if the living cells behind those therapies remain viable and
functional throughout the production processes. At **BioLife Solutions**, our mission is to protect
the integrity of cells and provide trusted tools, services, and expertise that can enable our
customers to advance the development and delivery of cell and gene therapies. We believe the future
of cell and gene therapies hinges on the integrity of every single cell and we are here to protect
that promise.

We understand the technical demands of bioprocessing in this field, and our advanced biopreservation
expertise, cell culture optimization products, innovative storage systems, and closed-system
manufacturing solutions are designed to enhance process efficiency, maintain cellular viability, and
ensure reproducibility at every stage. Whether scaling up from R&D, navigating clinical trials or
optimizing cryopreservation protocols for commercial production, we provide the tools and experience
to streamline your workflow and safeguard your therapies.

## Supporting Ebola Response: Rapid Diagnostics and Global Expertise

Advancing our commitment to public health, our teams are partnering to actively support Ebola
response efforts on the ground, expand diagnostic testing and strengthen laboratory capabilities.

[ Explore the Ebola Resource Hub ][207]

## Protecting Food. Protecting People.

Safe food isn't just a privilege; it is a necessity. An estimated 600 million people fall ill after
eating contaminated food annually, with approximately 420,000 losing their lives. Efficient,
reliable and fast diagnostic solutions play a crucial role in safety, quality and protecting
consumers worldwide.

[ Discover Food & Quality Safety Solutions ][208]

## Annual Report: Achievements Building a Healthier Future

bioMérieux’s Annual Report highlights the achievements shaping public health, innovation, and
environmental responsibility for our future. From strengthening the fight against AMR and sepsis to
accelerating sustainable solutions, our work continues driving better outcomes for people, our
communities and the planet.

[ Explore the 2025 Annual Report ][209]
[Elevating Education Across the Diagnostic Pathway]

## Elevating Education Across the Diagnostic Pathway

The newly launched Product Education Hub deepens diagnostic understanding with evidence‑based
resources. Leverage scientific materials, webinars, symposium highlights, case studies, and more to
drive more informed clinical decision‑making.

[ Discover the Hub ][210]

Advancing our commitment to public health, our teams are partnering to actively support Ebola

## Protecting Food. Protecting People.

Safe food isn't just a privilege; it is a necessity. An estimated 600 million people fall ill after
eating contaminated food annually, with approximately 420,000 losing their lives. Efficient,
reliable and fast diagnostic solutions play a crucial role in safety, quality and protecting
consumers worldwide.

[ Discover Food & Quality Safety Solutions ][208]

bioMérieux’s Annual Report highlights the achievements shaping public health, innovation, and

accelerating sustainable solutions, our work continues driving better outcomes for people, our
communities and the planet.

# World Leaders in Regenerative, Sports & Longevity Medicine

Helping you feel, move, and live better - without unnecessary surgeries or medications.
Regenerative treatments designed for lasting relief, enhanced mobility, and total body wellness.

[Find Out What's Possible for You][48]
[A serene exterior of a luxury home with an infinity pool overlooking the ocean at sunset. ]

## We See Health Differently

Dr. Matt Cook is a global thought leader and innovator in [regenerative medicine][49]. With over 20
years dedicated to advancing functional and regenerative treatments, he has developed a proprietary
multimodal approach that harnesses the body's natural healing power to address complex injuries and
cellular-level regeneration. All of our practitioners have trained under his guidance, ensuring you
receive precision medicine tailored to you.

For too long, medicine has focused on treating symptoms instead of finding solutions. At BioReset
Medical, we use [advanced therapies][50] and regenerative treatments to help your body heal from the
inside out. Whether you're dealing with chronic pain, recovering from an injury, or working to
optimize your health, we create a personalized plan that works for you—not just a one-size-fits-all
treatment.

We don’t just treat patients - we teach doctors worldwide. As leaders in [ultrasound-guided
therapies][51] and [regenerative medicine][52], we train physicians through BioReset University,
ensuring that the most effective techniques are shared across the globe.

[Dr. Matt Cook, founder of BioReset Medical.]

**What Is Regenerative Medicine & Concierge Care?

‍**Regenerative medicine uses biologic therapies - like PRP, stem cells, and peptides - to stimulate
your body’s natural healing processes. At BioReset Medical, our concierge model ensures you receive
direct access to world-class specialists, priority scheduling, and fully personalized treatment
plans.
‍

Whether you’re managing chronic pain, recovering from injury, or optimizing healthspan, our team
crafts solutions that address your unique needs - so you can reclaim your mobility, vitality, and
confidence.

**Benefits** **of Regenerative Concierge Care:

- Personalized Precision **Every treatment plan is custom-designed using advanced diagnostics and
one-on-one expert guidance.

**-** **Non-Surgical Relief **Minimally invasive therapies promote tissue regeneration and reduce
pain without the risks of surgery.

**-** **Seamless Concierge Experience **Direct access to specialists, immediate appointment

| 05/31/26]
Play Video
Play Video
13:17

### ASCO 2026: "The results that we presented from the RASolute 302 trial are unprecedented." - The
### CEO behind this year's pancreatic cancer breakthrough walks us through the full results and
### implications | 05/31/26

Dr. Mark Goldsmith of Revolution Medicines describes the benefit seen by advanced patients who
received the pancreatic cancer pill daraxonrasib vs those in a control group of investigator's
choice standard-of-care chemotherapy, and he discusses the medicine's side effect profile. Plus,
next steps for this treatment in pancreatic cancer and beyond.
[ASCO 2026: Bicara Therapeutics is presenting long-term follow up data at ASCO that it believes
shows durability derived from choosing TGF-β with EGFR for its fusion protein in HPV negative head &
neck | 05/31/26]
Play Video
Play Video
05:44

### ASCO 2026: Bicara Therapeutics is presenting long-term follow up data at ASCO that it believes
### shows durability derived from choosing TGF-β with EGFR for its fusion protein in HPV negative
### head & neck | 05/31/26

CEO Claire Mazumdar describes the ASCO data, and updates us on the phase 2/3 study, which is already
in the phase 3 portion. Bicara hopes to use the study to eventually gain an accelerated approval.
[ASCO 2026: Fresh off an IPO, Eikon Therapeutics Chairman & CEO Roger Perlmutter describes the
scientific idea behind the company, and walks us through the leading programs | 05/31/26]
Play Video
Play Video
35:05

### ASCO 2026: Fresh off an IPO, Eikon Therapeutics Chairman & CEO Roger Perlmutter describes the
### scientific idea behind the company, and walks us through the leading programs | 05/31/26

The lead two programs, which target TLR7/8 and PARP1, have data at ASCO and were licensed with the
idea of laying the foundation for clinical expertise at Eikon. Another clinical program, a WRN
helicase inhibitor, is the first to entirely come out of Eikon's platform. Plus, Dr. Perlmutter's
take on being a public company, and his thoughts on China as a medicine cabinet to the world.
[ASCO 2026: Summit Therapeutics' Co-CEO and Chief Strategy Officer discuss the HARMONi-6 ASCO data
release for the PD-1xVEGF bi-specific antibody Ivonescimab | 06/01/26]
Play Video
Play Video
14:55

### ASCO 2026: Summit Therapeutics' Co-CEO and Chief Strategy Officer discuss the HARMONi-6 ASCO
### data release for the PD-1xVEGF bi-specific antibody Ivonescimab | 06/01/26

Maky Zanganeh and Dave Gancarz share their take on the result, which at the topline showed that
Ivonescimab plus chemo reduced the risk of death by 34% vs the PD-1 Tislelizumab plus chemo, and
they are given the opportunity to respond to some of the pushback heard around McCormick Place.
[ASCO 2026: Celcuity CEO Brian Sullivan discusses the late breaking data for the PAM inhibitor
gedatolisib that was just presented at ASCO - doubled the likelihood of survival in HR+/HER2- breast
| 06/02/26]
Play Video
Play Video
09:22

### ASCO 2026: Celcuity CEO Brian Sullivan discusses the late breaking data for the PAM inhibitor
### gedatolisib that was just presented at ASCO - doubled the likelihood of survival in HR+/HER2-
### breast | 06/02/26

These data were for patients with the PIK3CA mutation. The median PFS for the gedatolisib triplet
combo was 11.1 months versus 5.6 months, compared to alpelisib plus fulvestrant.
[ASCO 2026: Immuneering presented an update of the P2 trial of its deep cyclic inhibitor of MEK in
1L pancreatic cancer at ASCO. CEO Ben Zeskind argues why competitor data should not overshadow this
| 06/1/26]
Play Video
Play Video

### ASCO 2026: Immuneering presented an update of the P2 trial of its deep cyclic inhibitor of MEK
### in 1L pancreatic cancer at ASCO. CEO Ben Zeskind argues why competitor data should not
### overshadow this | 06/1/26

He describes the data, which showed a 17.3 months median OS in 55 patients vs. 8.5 months for SoC,
and descrbies why he believes the therapy has an ideal profile for first line patients. A phase
three study is already active and accruing patients.

## Supporting progress & translation of gene & cell therapies

The aim of the British Society for Gene and Cell Therapy is to support scientific progress and
promote ethical and efficient translation of gene- and cell-based technologies from the laboratory
into the clinic.

## Become a Member

Subscribe as a BSGCT member to join our community and receive membership benefits

[Find out more][37]

## Annual Conference

Annual Conference 2026, Join us in Newcastle **15th – 17th April.**
Earlybird Registration to close **Monday 16th February **
Abstract deadline extended to **Friday 13th February**

[To find out more and book your place ][38]

The BSGCT ECDC sub-committee is inviting ECRs to take part in two free, pre-conference events
surrounding the BSGCT annual conference in Newcastle. Registrants can attend one or both of the
events.

[Find Out More][39]

# Introducing the Current and New Members of the BSGCT Board

We are delighted to introduce the current and newly appointed members of the BSGCT Board. We are
grateful to our existing Board members for their continued commitment and warmly welcome the new
members joining us as we work together to advance the field of gene and cell therapy.

[Vote Now][40]
[BSGCT Board]

The British Society for Gene and Cell Therapy (BSGCT) serves as a collaborative platform to advance
Gene and Cell Therapy (GCT) in the UK.

We proactively foster cooperation among stakeholders, including the public, patients, scientists,
companies, government, and media to support the optimal development of GCT technologies and
therapies.

Our charity is managed by volunteer members via an Elected-Board and Sub-Committees. We rely on the
crucial support of our sponsors and members and invite you to get involved.

[Find out more][41]

## Join Us

Become a member of the Society dedicated to support scientific progress

[Membership][42]

promote ethical and efficient translation of gene- and cell-based technologies from the laboratory
into the clinic.

events.

# Introducing the Current and New Members of the BSGCT Board

We are delighted to introduce the current and newly appointed members of the BSGCT Board. We are
grateful to our existing Board members for their continued commitment and warmly welcome the new
members joining us as we work together to advance the field of gene and cell therapy.

[Vote Now][40]
[BSGCT Board]

The British Society for Gene and Cell Therapy (BSGCT) serves as a collaborative platform to advance
Gene and Cell Therapy (GCT) in the UK.

We proactively foster cooperation among stakeholders, including the public, patients, scientists,
companies, government, and media to support the optimal development of GCT technologies and
therapies.

crucial support of our sponsors and members and invite you to get involved.

## 2nd Cell & Gene Therapy Global Congress 2024 Europe

The Fastest Growing Cell & Gene Therapy Networking Event. 
* Introduction
* Insight
* Who Should Attend

Cell and Gene therapies are forms of personalised, regenerative medicine. Described as the most
innovative, promising and life-changing new categories of medicines whose full potential is only
just beginning to emerge. They are cutting-edge and rapidly progressing fields of Biological
Therapies. Also known as “Advanced Therapy Medicinal Products”, they involved the use of cells,
tissues and genes to treat, prevent or potentially cure and eliminate complicated health conditions
and difficult to treat diseases. These therapies promise life-changing treatments for a broad
spectrum of complex diseases ranging from genetic conditions to cancers. Both approaches offer the
potential to diminish the fundamental cause of genetic and acquired diseases by substituting the
missing protein or cells causing the disease’s symptoms. Cell and gene therapies may offer longer
lasting effects than traditional medicines. Convergence of advanced biotechnology, precision
medicine, and expertise in manufacturing has facilitated the way for these therapies to become a
reality, with remarkable successes observed in conditions such as cancer and genetic disorders.

Cell and Gene therapy has transformed the healthcare and biopharma industry by storm. Currently,
after around 40 CGT launches across the EU and US, the market is worth around EUR 4.5 billion. A
similar number are expected to be approved by 2028, when sales are projected to rise to EUR 19.2
billion. The development of biological therapies is rapidly expanding, however, commercialisation of
this treatment poses different challenges to research and development, authorisation, manufacturing,
accessibility, and ensuring safety throughout the lifecycle of the product.

The two-day Congress will provide an interactive, cutting edge, and comprehensive discussions in
collaborative format led by key experts with intimate knowledge in the industry. Gain practical
strategies and best practices on challenges, innovations, technologies, and concepts to help you
gain access to the booming CGT market.

We are putting together an agenda that focuses on “driving innovation, addressing significant unmet
medical needs, and ultimately improving patient outcomes”.

We are gathering high calibre expert speakers to participate and share their knowledge and expertise
through Keynote Presentations and Panel discussions, addressing all aspects of the industry.

We look forward to welcoming you to the **CGT World Congress 2024!**

Sincerely yours,
Jocelyn Raguindin
Conference Director
**Paradigm Global Events / Facilitate Live**

## ERIC HALIOUA

President & Chief Executive Officer

Serial entrepreneur that combines strong strategic, technological and managerial experience with
proven track record of deal-making and fund-raising. During his career he achieved together with his
different teams to bring four drug candidates from research to the clinics (up to phase IIb).
Overall, Eric has raised as of now a total of more than €160 million from VCs and strategic partners
in Europe, USA, Japan and Korea and have had numerous successes in the sale and initial public
offering of biotechnology companies. He is CEO of the biotechnology company PDC*line Pharma and
board member of Essenscia (Bio.be). Eric is co-founder of four biotechnology companies called Myosix
(bought by Genzyme mid-2002), Murigenetics, HairClone and Digital Orthopaedics. He is co-Inventor of
the first GMP approved mobile manufacturing unit for cell therapy. Eric worked for 12 years in the
Healthcare and Life Sciences Practice of Arthur D. Little. Eric holds two master’s degrees in
pharmacology and Molecular Biology and a MBA from ESSEC business school (Paris, France), with an
advanced degree from the Health Care ESSEC chair.
[
][63]

## [ Jeff Liter ][64]

CEO

OX2 Therapeutics

## Jeff Liter

CEO

Jeff is a seasoned CEO with a proven track record at profitably growing emerging companies and
business divisions. He has raised over $15M in seed capital from angel investors to start four
different companies which he then led to becoming profitable or acquired. Jeff got his start in Cell
therapy as the Chief Operating Officer of Progenitor Cell Therapy (PCT) where he supported over 25
clinical trials in the Cell and Gene Therapy field. These trials ranged from Phase I to Phase III
pivotal trials. Some highlights include: Responsible for tech transferring Kite’s T-Cell therapy out
of the NIH, Novartis’ cell therapy out of UPenn and Adaptimmume’s cell therapy out of UPenn. Led
B-MoGen Biotechnologies to develop TcBuster the first industry wide transposon tool for the cell
therapy space. Has led Luminary Therapeutics to an approved Phase I IND for Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma
with a novel ligand CAR that has three distinct antigens – directed to overcome the 25% patient
relapse rates due to antigen escape. Has led OX2 Therapeutics to a Phase I clinical trial for
recurrent Glioblastoma.
[
][65]

## [ Alex Blyth ][66]

Founder & CEO

Lift Biosciences

## Alex Blyth

Founder & CEO

Serial entrepreneur and inventor with a background in biology and economics. Alex is a serial
entrepreneur and inventor with a background in biology and economics. With 20 years of biopharma
experience, Alex has been instrumental in bringing first-in-class assets like T-Vec, Erbitux, and
Abraxane to market. Previously, he served as Managing Director of Cello Business Sciences and
Vice-President of Cello Health Consulting. Founded LIfT BioSciences after losing his mother to
pancreatic cancer and promising his daughter they would stop other little girls losing their
grandmothers. The company builds on the research of leading immunologists Prof. Zheng Cui and Dr.
Lloyd J. Old, who identified defective neutrophils in cancer patients and demonstrated their
correction could lead to tumour remission. LIfT BioSciences has developed a new area of science
where neutrophils serve as the backbone of an effective immune system. LIfT has developed
Immuno-modulatory Alpha Neutrophils (IMANs), which infiltrate solid tumors, modulate the tumour
microenvironment, and recruit other immune cells to destroy tumours with enhanced persistence and
proliferation. The company is entering Phase 1 clinical trials for their Immuno-Cell Therapy
Platform and is exploring other therapeutic modalities, including treatments for auto-immune
diseases, neurological conditions, and infectious diseases.

## 2nd Cell & Gene Therapy Global Congress 2024 Europe

The Fastest Growing Cell & Gene Therapy Networking Event. 
* Introduction
* Insight
* Who Should Attend

Cell and Gene therapies are forms of personalised, regenerative medicine. Described as the most
innovative, promising and life-changing new categories of medicines whose full potential is only
just beginning to emerge. They are cutting-edge and rapidly progressing fields of Biological
Therapies. Also known as “Advanced Therapy Medicinal Products”, they involved the use of cells,
tissues and genes to treat, prevent or potentially cure and eliminate complicated health conditions
and difficult to treat diseases. These therapies promise life-changing treatments for a broad
spectrum of complex diseases ranging from genetic conditions to cancers. Both approaches offer the
potential to diminish the fundamental cause of genetic and acquired diseases by substituting the
missing protein or cells causing the disease’s symptoms. Cell and gene therapies may offer longer
lasting effects than traditional medicines. Convergence of advanced biotechnology, precision
medicine, and expertise in manufacturing has facilitated the way for these therapies to become a
reality, with remarkable successes observed in conditions such as cancer and genetic disorders.

Cell and Gene therapy has transformed the healthcare and biopharma industry by storm. Currently,
after around 40 CGT launches across the EU and US, the market is worth around EUR 4.5 billion. A
similar number are expected to be approved by 2028, when sales are projected to rise to EUR 19.2
billion. The development of biological therapies is rapidly expanding, however, commercialisation of
this treatment poses different challenges to research and development, authorisation, manufacturing,
accessibility, and ensuring safety throughout the lifecycle of the product.

The two-day Congress will provide an interactive, cutting edge, and comprehensive discussions in
collaborative format led by key experts with intimate knowledge in the industry. Gain practical
strategies and best practices on challenges, innovations, technologies, and concepts to help you
gain access to the booming CGT market.

We are putting together an agenda that focuses on “driving innovation, addressing significant unmet
medical needs, and ultimately improving patient outcomes”.

We are gathering high calibre expert speakers to participate and share their knowledge and expertise

We look forward to welcoming you to the **CGT World Congress 2024!**

## ERIC HALIOUA

President & Chief Executive Officer

Serial entrepreneur that combines strong strategic, technological and managerial experience with
proven track record of deal-making and fund-raising. During his career he achieved together with his
different teams to bring four drug candidates from research to the clinics (up to phase IIb).
Overall, Eric has raised as of now a total of more than €160 million from VCs and strategic partners
in Europe, USA, Japan and Korea and have had numerous successes in the sale and initial public
offering of biotechnology companies. He is CEO of the biotechnology company PDC*line Pharma and
board member of Essenscia (Bio.be). Eric is co-founder of four biotechnology companies called Myosix
(bought by Genzyme mid-2002), Murigenetics, HairClone and Digital Orthopaedics. He is co-Inventor of
the first GMP approved mobile manufacturing unit for cell therapy. Eric worked for 12 years in the
Healthcare and Life Sciences Practice of Arthur D. Little. Eric holds two master’s degrees in
pharmacology and Molecular Biology and a MBA from ESSEC business school (Paris, France), with an
advanced degree from the Health Care ESSEC chair.

clinical trials in the Cell and Gene Therapy field. These trials ranged from Phase I to Phase III

B-MoGen Biotechnologies to develop TcBuster the first industry wide transposon tool for the cell
therapy space. Has led Luminary Therapeutics to an approved Phase I IND for Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma
with a novel ligand CAR that has three distinct antigens – directed to overcome the 25% patient
relapse rates due to antigen escape. Has led OX2 Therapeutics to a Phase I clinical trial for
recurrent Glioblastoma.

diseases, neurological conditions, and infectious diseases.

# TALEN^{®} for Best-In-Class Gene Editing

Cellectis leverages its leadership in gene editing through its flagship technology, TALEN^{®}, which
allows the company to create CAR T therapies to **bring new hope to cancer patients through broadly
available, off-the-shelf therapies**. TALEN^{®} has been successfully used in the clinic to solve
key challenges with allogeneic CAR T including protection from Graft vs. Host Disease, mitigation of
rejection and enhanced safety via the integration of a suicide switch.

[Learn more][36]

"Off-the-shelf" immunotherapies
that can work for the largest number of patients

Cellectis gene-edits “Chimeric Antigen Receptor” (CAR) T-cells from healthy donors into
“off-the-shelf” immunotherapy product candidates that are designed to work for the largest number of
patients. It’s the difference between being an off-the-shelf product and a service in which each
treatment has to be custom-made. This same technology, developed by Cellectis, could help in
designing therapies for many other diseases.

[Learn more][37]

Strong intellectual property,
global strategic partnerships.

25 years of innovation. more than 100 patent families. 300 granted patents and 200 applications.
Global strategic partnerships with Allogene, Servier, Iovance, Primera and AstraZeneca

# TALEN^{®} for Best-In-Class Gene Editing

Cellectis leverages its leadership in gene editing through its flagship technology, TALEN^{®}, which
allows the company to create CAR T therapies to **bring new hope to cancer patients through broadly
available, off-the-shelf therapies**. TALEN^{®} has been successfully used in the clinic to solve
key challenges with allogeneic CAR T including protection from Graft vs. Host Disease, mitigation of
rejection and enhanced safety via the integration of a suicide switch.

[Learn more][36]

"Off-the-shelf" immunotherapies
that can work for the largest number of patients

Cellectis gene-edits “Chimeric Antigen Receptor” (CAR) T-cells from healthy donors into
“off-the-shelf” immunotherapy product candidates that are designed to work for the largest number of
patients. It’s the difference between being an off-the-shelf product and a service in which each
treatment has to be custom-made. This same technology, developed by Cellectis, could help in
designing therapies for many other diseases.

[Learn more][37]

Strong intellectual property,
global strategic partnerships.

25 years of innovation. more than 100 patent families. 300 granted patents and 200 applications.
Global strategic partnerships with Allogene, Servier, Iovance, Primera and AstraZeneca

[Learn more][38]

# The future of cell therapy manufacturing is automated.

[ Book an in-person visit ][8] [ Explore a facility in 3D ][9]

## Constellation® is the automated cell therapy manufacturing platform for flexible scale-up.

The next generation of cell therapies need a new manufacturing model. Constellation is a fully
automated robotic platform enabling flexible, low-risk manufacturing expansion for autologous and
allogeneic cell therapies.

[image alt text ]

### End-to-end production.

Highest operational efficiency. Lowest cost-per-dose. 

[image alt text ]

### Facility
### flexibility.

Add capacity incrementally. Adapt layouts as needs evolve.

[image alt text ]

### Payback in
### <1 year.

ROI delivered in ~11 months.

[image alt text ]

### GMP instruments.

Integration with your validated instruments and consumables.

[Why Constellation®?][10]

## A new standard for scale-up.

What makes Constellation unique is that the system scales by adding capacity to specific
manufacturing steps, rather than unnecessarily duplicating entire blocks. Modular workstations and
mobile robots enable flexible expansion, higher facility utilisation, and a manufacturing system
that grows with you.



### Modular workstations

The chosen facility is configured with workstations for each manufacturing unit operation, in the
right ratio for maximum utilisation. Workstations contain validated GMP instruments.



### Mobile robots

Instead of people moving materials, mobile robots transport consumables and cell material between
workstations and execute every step precisely in sequence. A small team of operators supervise and
input materials.



### Sterile fluid transfer

Cell materials remain in a closed system throughout, with FDA-approved tube welding creating sealed
fluid connections between every unit operation.



### Total digital integration

Overseeing all of this is a single software layer that orchestrates the workflow, tracks every
action, and generates complete digital batch records of cell therapy manufacturing.

[Discover the technology][11]

## The biology you've perfected, at the scale you need.

[Constellation ][12]is designed to transform labour-intensive cell therapy production into a
coordinated, scalable operation. The platform integrates seamlessly with your existing biology,
process and supply chain, using validated GMP instruments and consumables.

Constellation can be deployed in your facility, or we work with selected CDMO partners to provide a
wholly outsourced manufacturing solution.

[cell therapy industrialisation]

## Powered by partnership.

We work side-by-side with industry-leading technology providers to integrate GMP instruments and
consumables - such as the Sefia Select™, Cue® and G-Rex® - into one coordinated platform. This
ensures automation preserves the biological performance therapy developers have achieved.

Together, we are creating the infrastructure needed to make commercial cell therapy manufacturing
viable at global scale.

[Our instrument partners][13]

## Return on investment in less than 12 months.

Constellation is a capital investment that pays for itself quickly by establishing efficient
manufacturing operations from day one. Independent modelling by PM Group, presented at Interphex
2025, shows that Constellation delivers packback in around 11 months.

This graph compares the estimated annual operating costs (OPEX) of different cell therapy
manufacturing approaches.

[cell therapy industrialisation]
[image alt text ]

### 90%

reduction in labour requirements

[image alt text ]

### 30x

more space efficient

[image alt text ]

### 51%

reduction in COGS

[image alt text ]

### 24/7

continuous manufacturing

[Explore a facility in 3D][14]

We'll be in touch to schedule a discovery call or in-person visit.
