# The future of cell therapy manufacturing is automated.

[ Book an in-person visit ][8] [ Explore a facility in 3D ][9]

## Constellation® is the automated cell therapy manufacturing platform for flexible scale-up.

The next generation of cell therapies need a new manufacturing model. Constellation is a fully
automated robotic platform enabling flexible, low-risk manufacturing expansion for autologous and
allogeneic cell therapies.

[image alt text ]

### End-to-end production.

Highest operational efficiency. Lowest cost-per-dose. 

[image alt text ]

### Facility
### flexibility.

Add capacity incrementally. Adapt layouts as needs evolve.

[image alt text ]

### Payback in
### <1 year.

ROI delivered in ~11 months.

[image alt text ]

### GMP instruments.

Integration with your validated instruments and consumables.

[Why Constellation®?][10]

## A new standard for scale-up.

What makes Constellation unique is that the system scales by adding capacity to specific
manufacturing steps, rather than unnecessarily duplicating entire blocks. Modular workstations and
mobile robots enable flexible expansion, higher facility utilisation, and a manufacturing system
that grows with you.



### Modular workstations

The chosen facility is configured with workstations for each manufacturing unit operation, in the
right ratio for maximum utilisation. Workstations contain validated GMP instruments.



### Mobile robots

Instead of people moving materials, mobile robots transport consumables and cell material between
workstations and execute every step precisely in sequence. A small team of operators supervise and
input materials.



### Sterile fluid transfer

Cell materials remain in a closed system throughout, with FDA-approved tube welding creating sealed
fluid connections between every unit operation.



### Total digital integration

Overseeing all of this is a single software layer that orchestrates the workflow, tracks every
action, and generates complete digital batch records of cell therapy manufacturing.

[Discover the technology][11]

## The biology you've perfected, at the scale you need.

[Constellation ][12]is designed to transform labour-intensive cell therapy production into a
coordinated, scalable operation. The platform integrates seamlessly with your existing biology,
process and supply chain, using validated GMP instruments and consumables.

Constellation can be deployed in your facility, or we work with selected CDMO partners to provide a
wholly outsourced manufacturing solution.

[cell therapy industrialisation]

## Powered by partnership.

We work side-by-side with industry-leading technology providers to integrate GMP instruments and
consumables - such as the Sefia Select™, Cue® and G-Rex® - into one coordinated platform. This
ensures automation preserves the biological performance therapy developers have achieved.

Together, we are creating the infrastructure needed to make commercial cell therapy manufacturing
viable at global scale.

[Our instrument partners][13]

## Return on investment in less than 12 months.

Constellation is a capital investment that pays for itself quickly by establishing efficient
manufacturing operations from day one. Independent modelling by PM Group, presented at Interphex
2025, shows that Constellation delivers packback in around 11 months.

Welcome to Cencora

# Find solutions that pave a reliable path to patients

Explore our full range of solutions designed to help you bring innovations to market and improve
care delivery worldwide.
[ Explore our solutions ][90]
[A light-skinned person wearing a white track jacket and a bright t-shirt jogging through a park
with the morning sun shining behind their head.]

## Distribution, commercialization, patient access, and pharmacy solutions for manufacturers,
## providers, and health systems.

We combine global capabilities and local expertise to help healthcare professionals bring
life-saving therapies, preventive treatments, and high-quality care to communities around the world.

[Logistics and warehousing][91] **

Leverage our global network to ensure safe, secure storage and timely delivery worldwide.

[ Drug research and clinical development support ][92] **

Streamline the drug development process and minimize go-to-market risk.

[ Commercialization support ][93] **

Build a foundation for a successful product launch and accelerate your speed-to-market.

[ Patient access and adherence support ][94] **

Address barriers to patient access and increase your product's speed-to-therapy.

[ Wholesale and specialty distribution ][95] **

Increase access to medications with our innovative solutions and secure supply chain.

[ Provider solutions ][96] **

Elevate the patient experience and expand care possibilities with physician practice solutions.

[ Pharmacy solutions ][97] **

Build and scale your pharmacy, accelerate growth, and deliver stronger clinical results.

[ Hospital and health system solutions ][98] **

Solve critical problems, plan for sustainable growth, and create better health outcomes.

[ Explore our capabilities ][99]

## Why Cencora

The end-to-end support we provide across the entire healthcare spectrum isn’t the only thing that
sets Cencora apart. There are so many other ways we provide a differentiated experience when you tap
into our unique capabilities.

### Global reach with local expertise

With a presence in over 50 countries, we’re expanding access to care worldwide, while our
community-level insight helps us to deploy resources effectively and efficiently.
[ Learn more about our global reach ][100]

### A commitment to innovation

Together with our industry partners, we’re continuously innovating to meet the needs of our
customers, evolving our solutions, and reshaping how healthcare is delivered.
[ Learn more about our innovation commitment ][101]

### A partner-centric  approach

We work closely with pharma companies and care providers every day, listening to their challenges
and using their insights to develop solutions that will have a positive impact on their patients.
[ Learn more about us ][102]

## What is Cencora?

It’s not easy to fully understand everything Cencora does. With countless solutions and services for
manufacturers, health systems, government entities, physician practices, pharmacies, and more, it’s
practically impossible for us to summarize what we offer without sacrificing some very important
details.

Watch this video to see some of our team members trying to define Cencora, and then check out our
stories to gain deeper insight into our business, our purpose, and our impact.
[ Explore all of our stories ][103]

while decreasing the overall operating costs.

marketplace.

###### Loxoprofen

[Read More][63]
[Beyfortus®]

###### Beyfortus®

A novel drug launched in India to protect newborns and infants from lung infections caused by
Respiratory Syncytial Virus in the first season of exposure.

[Read more][64]
[Colozo®]

###### Colozo®

A USFDA-approved option for Chronic Idiopathic Constipation in adults, which acts on gut receptors
to help support normal digestive function.

[Read more][65]

## Accelerating Access to 
## Affordable and Innovative Medicines
## 
## Our latest launches that bring innovative solutions to patients across the world

[Toripalimab-image]

###### Toripalimab

The first immunotherapy approved by major global regulators for recurrent or metastatic
nasopharyngeal carcinoma (RM-NPC). In India, it introduces immuno-oncology as a first-line treatment
for RM-NPC in combination with chemotherapy.

[Read More][66]
[Bevacizumab-image]

###### Bevacizumab

Our first biosimilar approved and launched in the UK. It is a treatment for several types of cancer,
including colorectal, lung, brain, kidney, cervical, and ovarian cancers. Bevacizumab works by
blocking a protein called VEGF, slowing the growth and spread of cancer.

[Read More][67]
[Lenacapavir-image]

###### Lenacapavir

A long-acting, USFDA-approved treatment for HIV-1 infection. Our work with Lenacapavir supports our
goal to expand HIV treatment and prevention, especially in high-burden regions. We aim to
manufacture and commercialise Lenacapavir across 120 countries, in partnership with Gilead Sciences.

[Read More][68]

## Helping Patients Navigate Their Treatment Journey

[Learn More][69]
[Vega Club]

#### Vega Club

A patient support program where gastroenterologists help people with ulcerative colitis better
understand and manage Inflammatory Bowel Disease through personalised guidance on diet, exercise,
and stress.

[betaCare]

#### betaCare

An initiative in Germany providing useful health information to patients. It also offers certified
online courses to improve patient care, and help them navigate treatment and the healthcare system.

[Joint Health Revolution]

#### Joint Health Revolution

Sessions developed for individuals with osteoarthritis, designed to guide them in understanding
effective joint care. These doctor-led sessions help patients learn about the right exercises,
healthy habits and ways to manage pain, and stay active.

[Learn More][70]

## Partnerships That Improve Access to Good Health
## 
## We work together with our partners to bring healthcare solutions across communities

[Gates Foundation]

###### Gates Foundation

Working to develop an injectable contraceptive for low and middle income countries, advancing
women's health, improving family planning options, and reducing health inequities.

[Read More][71]
[Sanofi]

###### Sanofi

Partnering to distribute pediatric and adult vaccines in India, expanding immunization coverage, and
strengthening disease prevention.

[Read more][72]
[Alvotech]

###### Alvotech

Collaborating to expand access to essential cancer therapies approved for more than 40 types of
cancer, strengthening oncology care and supporting patients with high-burden diseases worldwide.

[Read more][73]

## 
## Our teams are solving complex challenges with science and technology, keeping patients at the
## core

## From Doing Less Harm to Maximal Good
## 
## We continue working towards reducing our environmental footprint, addressing ecological risks
## from our operations, and are progressing towards carbon neutrality

[Learn More][76]
[Water]

#### Environment

###### Water

By implementing initiatives such as wastewater recovery, grey water use, and more, we reduced
freshwater consumption by ~70,000 KL from April to September 2023.

[Climate Risk Mapping and Scope 3 Reduction image]

###### Climate Risk Mapping and Scope 3 Reduction

By conducting site-level climate risk assessments and improving supplier engagement by sustainable
procurement, we identified key vulnerabilities and reduced Scope 3 emissions intensity by 31% since
FY2023.

[Waste Reduction through Process Efficiency image]

###### Waste Reduction through Process Efficiency

By implementing cost improvement projects and strengthening site-level waste checks, we achieved
20-22% reduction in waste across 9 high-volume products. 

[Decarbonisation Through Renewable Energy image]

###### Decarbonisation Through Renewable Energy

By replacing fossil fuels with biofuels in boilers and expanding solar, wind, and hybrid energy use,
we reduced Scope 1 and 2 emissions by 33% vs FY2023. Energy-saving initiatives also helped avoid
8,073 tonnes of CO₂ and saved 7.75 million kWh in FY2025.

[Learn More][77]

By implementing initiatives such as wastewater recovery, grey water use, and more, we reduced
freshwater consumption by ~70,000 KL from April to September 2023.

By conducting site-level climate risk assessments and improving supplier engagement by sustainable
procurement, we identified key vulnerabilities and reduced Scope 3 emissions intensity by 31% since
FY2023.

###### Waste Reduction through Process Efficiency

By implementing cost improvement projects and strengthening site-level waste checks, we achieved
20-22% reduction in waste across 9 high-volume products.

we reduced Scope 1 and 2 emissions by 33% vs FY2023. Energy-saving initiatives also helped avoid
8,073 tonnes of CO₂ and saved 7.75 million kWh in FY2025.

## YOUR CHEMISTRY, MANUFACTURING AND CONTROLS, (CMC) DEEPER DEPARTMENT

# DSI IS THE LEADER IN REGULATORY DRUG DEVELOPMENT

## ARE YOU DEVELOPING PRODUCTS WITH THE INTENTION OF MARKETING, LICENSING, OR DIVESTING?

DSI provides regulatory, technical, and project management consulting services to healthcare product
companies that manufacture and/or market pharmaceuticals, biopharmaceuticals, animal health, and
cellular and gene therapy products.

Since 2007 we have provided our clients with innovative strategies and exceptional quality work
products intended to enhance product development, approval, and marketing presence.

Whether advocating CMC strategy, directing CMC operations or developing CMC submission content that
represent the best interests of emerging biotech, we focus on the critical CMC issues and build
programs that enhance development.

### WHAT CAN YOU EXPECT FROM DSI?

All the expertise you need under one roof

There is no need to hire multiple consultants. DSI has all the expertise you need to advance your
product development and regulatory approval programs.

Breadth of experience

DSI helps clients develop many types of regulated products. We have worked with companies to develop
and obtain marketing clearance for drugs, and biologics in many therapeutic areas, including
oncology, cardiovascular disease, metabolic disorders, and neurology.

Flexibility and responsiveness

We understand our client’s need to reach company goals quickly. We are there when you need us and
can provide a quick answer to a question or full product development support.

Deep knowledge of regulatory expectations

Our understanding of regulatory expectations comes from knowledge gained from experiences with other
clients, products, and regulatory agency interactions.

Professional, experienced consultants

DSI’s staff includes technical, and regulatory professionals, most with more than 15 years of
experience in product development and marketed product support. DSI’s consultants have worked with
FDA regulators in CMO’s and pharmaceutical and emerging biotech companies.

### PRE-IND

Collaborate to assess your product development plan, identify the appropriate pathway for approval,
define all applicable technical and regulatory requirements, support preparation of critical
toxicology materials, develop test methods and craft a customized product development strategy that
minimizes cost and time to clinical trials. Hands-on leadership at meetings with the Agency as well

the IND review process.

[DS InPharmatics (DSI) CMC Erlenmeyer flask on shield white on teal icon]

### PHASE 1

Unique “industry” perspective to help generate the “right” data and interpret Agency requests and
communications as well as to provide guidance on the latest thinking, positioning your new product
for a successful outcome. Our team prides itself on quickly and accurately interpreting requests and
comments, giving the not the most conservative advice but the advice we would stand behind and
support, eliminating the guesswork and costly delays that plague many interactions.

[DS InPharmatics (DSI) double-sided capsule and tablet with starred ribbon approval grey on beige
icon]

### END OF PHASE 2

Integrated project management, supports your trial efforts with quality/compliance and regulatory
customized to your product. From selecting the vendor for commercial material to the oversight of
development studies and manufacturing, establishing stability indicating testing methodology, to a
“phase appropriate” recommendation or review of data generated by Phase 3 studies, our regulatory
CMC team brings strategic insights, compliance knowledge and industry experience necessary to ensure
your studies are successful and part of an efficient overall regulatory strategy.

### PHASE 3 PIVOTAL

Experts in product manufacturing and testing requirements – knowledge that we leverage to boost your
chances of a successful Marketing application. Successful applications require that GMPs are
strictly adhered to ensuring every lot is substantially equivalent, safe and effective. Established
product development plans that encompass all aspects of testing, manufacturing, stability, storage,
packaging and labelling and preparation for validation of manufacturing so you can rest assured that

give that added confidence that your product will be successful.

[DS InPharmatics (DSI) Erlenmeyer flask with arrow pointing to mouth white on light teal icon]

### PRE-MARKETING

Well positioned to assist your organization in preparing and submitting your marketing application
(NDA/BLA/MAA). During the Authoring process, we provide hands-on support, leadership at agency
meetings and guidance in interpreting Agency interactions. Our team can help translate development
data and reports into a compelling story that will resonate with FDA reviewers, evaluate supply
chain choices and justify any gaps in development and reasons why guidance was not followed to
ensure accuracy, compliance and the best possible outcome. Hands on support and troubleshooting of
issues during validation.

[DS InPharmatics (DSI) life preserver to save drug development program grey on beige icon]

### POST APPROVAL

Once your product has been approved and is ready to go to market, the DSI team is able to provide
assistance in overseeing manufacturing and quality control, drafting required updates and post
approval change control for the FDA and assisting your team through additional development and
commercialization processes, including re-positioning the FDA application for international
regulatory approvals, life cycle products and physician materials.

All the expertise you need under one roof

There is no need to hire multiple consultants. DSI has all the expertise you need to advance your

Breadth of experience

and obtain marketing clearance for drugs, and biologics in many therapeutic areas, including
oncology, cardiovascular disease, metabolic disorders, and neurology.

Flexibility and responsiveness

We understand our client’s need to reach company goals quickly. We are there when you need us and

Deep knowledge of regulatory expectations

Our understanding of regulatory expectations comes from knowledge gained from experiences with other
clients, products, and regulatory agency interactions.

Professional, experienced consultants

DSI’s staff includes technical, and regulatory professionals, most with more than 15 years of
experience in product development and marketed product support. DSI’s consultants have worked with
FDA regulators in CMO’s and pharmaceutical and emerging biotech companies.

## Every Step of the way: DSI’s Expertise

Our team of expert consultants bring decades of experience to every stage of the regulatory and
product development process, from initial selection of development and manufacturing sources, design
and evaluation of the investigational manufacturing process thru the scale-up for commercialization.

[LEARN MORE ABOUT DSI’S EXPERTISE][86]
[[Regulatory drug development]][87]
[DS InPharmatics (DSI) analytics checklist for with test tube white on yellow-orange icon]

### PRE-IND

Collaborate to assess your product development plan, identify the appropriate pathway for approval,
define all applicable technical and regulatory requirements, support preparation of critical
toxicology materials, develop test methods and craft a customized product development strategy that
minimizes cost and time to clinical trials. Hands-on leadership at meetings with the Agency as well
as support for your regulatory interaction and IND submission. Advice every step of the way during
the IND review process.

[DS InPharmatics (DSI) CMC Erlenmeyer flask on shield white on teal icon]

### PHASE 1

Unique “industry” perspective to help generate the “right” data and interpret Agency requests and
communications as well as to provide guidance on the latest thinking, positioning your new product
for a successful outcome. Our team prides itself on quickly and accurately interpreting requests and
comments, giving the not the most conservative advice but the advice we would stand behind and
support, eliminating the guesswork and costly delays that plague many interactions.

[DS InPharmatics (DSI) double-sided capsule and tablet with starred ribbon approval grey on beige
icon]

### END OF PHASE 2

Integrated project management, supports your trial efforts with quality/compliance and regulatory
customized to your product. From selecting the vendor for commercial material to the oversight of
development studies and manufacturing, establishing stability indicating testing methodology, to a
“phase appropriate” recommendation or review of data generated by Phase 3 studies, our regulatory
CMC team brings strategic insights, compliance knowledge and industry experience necessary to ensure
your studies are successful and part of an efficient overall regulatory strategy.

[DS InPharmatics (DSI) magnifying glass reviewing process development for tablet white on orange
icon]

### PHASE 3 PIVOTAL

Experts in product manufacturing and testing requirements – knowledge that we leverage to boost your
chances of a successful Marketing application. Successful applications require that GMPs are
strictly adhered to ensuring every lot is substantially equivalent, safe and effective. Established
product development plans that encompass all aspects of testing, manufacturing, stability, storage,
packaging and labelling and preparation for validation of manufacturing so you can rest assured that
your operations are fully compliant. Gap-risk assessments of programs, filings and contractors to
give that added confidence that your product will be successful.

[DS InPharmatics (DSI) Erlenmeyer flask with arrow pointing to mouth white on light teal icon]

### PRE-MARKETING

Well positioned to assist your organization in preparing and submitting your marketing application
(NDA/BLA/MAA). During the Authoring process, we provide hands-on support, leadership at agency
meetings and guidance in interpreting Agency interactions. Our team can help translate development
data and reports into a compelling story that will resonate with FDA reviewers, evaluate supply
chain choices and justify any gaps in development and reasons why guidance was not followed to
ensure accuracy, compliance and the best possible outcome. Hands on support and troubleshooting of
issues during validation.

[DS InPharmatics (DSI) life preserver to save drug development program grey on beige icon]

### POST APPROVAL

Once your product has been approved and is ready to go to market, the DSI team is able to provide
assistance in overseeing manufacturing and quality control, drafting required updates and post
approval change control for the FDA and assisting your team through additional development and
commercialization processes, including re-positioning the FDA application for international
regulatory approvals, life cycle products and physician materials.

# Introducing
# Keenova and Par Health

On July 31, 2025, Mallinckrodt and Endo joined together to better serve patients and customers with
a bold plan for the future. Following the merger, the combined company then spun off its generics
and sterile injectables business as an independent company—Par Health—and rebranded the specialty
therapeutics company as Keenova Therapeutics in November 2025. 

Today, Keenova and Par Health operate as separate companies, each with its own mission and identity.
Please select the one you would like to visit.

Keenova strives to help patients with rare, stigmatized, or unaddressed conditions live happier and
healthier lives. Our areas of focus include, among others, immunology, urology, hepatology,
ophthalmology, orthopedics, and critical care.

[ Keenova.com ][6]

Par Health is the essential pharmaceutical company. We develop high-quality generics, sterile
injectables, and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), supported by a robust, U.S.-advantaged
manufacturing network. With over 4,000 team members worldwide, we believe great healthcare is built
on getting the essentials right.

# Introducing
# Keenova and Par Health

On July 31, 2025, Mallinckrodt and Endo joined together to better serve patients and customers with
a bold plan for the future. Following the merger, the combined company then spun off its generics
and sterile injectables business as an independent company—Par Health—and rebranded the specialty
therapeutics company as Keenova Therapeutics in November 2025. 

Today, Keenova and Par Health operate as separate companies, each with its own mission and identity.
Please select the one you would like to visit.

Keenova strives to help patients with rare, stigmatized, or unaddressed conditions live happier and
healthier lives. Our areas of focus include, among others, immunology, urology, hepatology,
ophthalmology, orthopedics, and critical care.

[ Keenova.com ][6]

Par Health is the essential pharmaceutical company. We develop high-quality generics, sterile
injectables, and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), supported by a robust, U.S.-advantaged
manufacturing network. With over 4,000 team members worldwide, we believe great healthcare is built
on getting the essentials right.

across every stage of your CMC journey — from early-phase strategy to process development, GMP
manufacturing and commercialisation.

## Your End-to-End Cell & Gene Therapy Partner

For over 20 years, eXmoor Pharma has been at the forefront of cell and gene therapy, supporting
biotech innovators from early-phase development to full-scale GMP manufacturing. Our unique blend of
consultancy and CDMO expertise means we don’t just manufacture—we provide strategic guidance to
ensure therapies are commercially viable from day one.

We combine CMC consultancy, process development, analytical services and GMP manufacturing to
provide comprehensive support across Viral Vectors, Autologous and Allogeneic Cell Therapies, and
RNA technologies. This integrated model enables seamless progression from early-phase strategy
through to commercial readiness.

With a 70% repeat business rate and 190+ clients worldwide, we are more than a service provider—we
are your long-term partner in success.

* Brief News
  
  ### AI assistant enhances access to Investor Relations information
  
  Today, Fresenius has launched the AI-powered assistant – “AskFRE” – on its Investor Relations (IR)
  website, marking an important step in advancing its digital capital markets communications. The
  solution is a joint initiative of the Fresenius AI Center of Excellence and the Investor Relations
  team.With AskFRE, visitors can now interact with an integrated AI chatbot that provides direct
  answers to capital market-relevant information. This includes financial results, company updates
  and other IR content – based exclusively on publicly available Fresenius disclosures.In an
  increasingly fast-paced and data-driven environment, digital investor relations play a key role in
  delivering timely, transparent and stakeholder-focused communication. AskFRE supports this
  ambition by enabling more intuitive access to financial information and tailored user
  interactions, while reinforcing the consistency and accessibility of Fresenius’ disclosures.With
  AskFRE, Fresenius underscores its commitment to advancing a best in class digital investor
  relations experience.AskFRE is now available: https://www.fresenius.com/AskFRE-Your-IR-Assistant
  
   
  
  May 26, 2026 · Fresenius

* Brief News
  
  ### Fresenius publishes 2025 Annual Report – REJUVENATE: Delivering accelerated performance for
  ### long-term value creation
  
  Today, Fresenius published its 2025 Annual Report. As announced in late February 2026, 2025 marked
  another strong year of performance and the launch of the current phase of the #FutureFresenius
  strategy: Rejuvenate. Despite headwinds, the healthcare group achieved its outlook, which was
  raised twice during the year. Group revenue before special items rose to €22.6 billion, with
  organic growth of 7%, while constant currency Core EPS (excluding FMC) increased by 12%. “Over the
  past three years, we have successfully implemented our #FutureFresenius strategy and created a new
  Fresenius that is innovative, relevant, resilient, and adaptable. At the same time, we have
  significantly bolstered our company’s economic strength. We aim to build on this strong
  foundation,” said Michael Sen, Chairman of the Management Board of Fresenius. The 2025 Annual
  Report demonstrates how Fresenius is creating sustainable value for all stakeholders by executing
  its #FutureFresenius strategy. It includes the Sustainability Statement in accordance with the
  European Sustainability Reporting Standards (ESRS), and is available as a PDF and as an
  interactive online version in German and English. The online report features additional business
  stories and includes a video statement from CEO Michael Sen.
  
   
  
  March 25, 2026 · Fresenius

  ### Fresenius publishes 2025 Annual Report – REJUVENATE: Delivering accelerated performance for
  ### long-term value creation
  
  Today, Fresenius published its 2025 Annual Report. As announced in late February 2026, 2025 marked
  another strong year of performance and the launch of the current phase of the #FutureFresenius
  strategy: Rejuvenate. Despite headwinds, the healthcare group achieved its outlook, which was
  raised twice during the year. Group revenue before special items rose to €22.6 billion, with
  organic growth of 7%, while constant currency Core EPS (excluding FMC) increased by 12%. “Over the
  past three years, we have successfully implemented our #FutureFresenius strategy and created a new
  Fresenius that is innovative, relevant, resilient, and adaptable. At the same time, we have
  significantly bolstered our company’s economic strength. We aim to build on this strong
  foundation,” said Michael Sen, Chairman of the Management Board of Fresenius. The 2025 Annual
  Report demonstrates how Fresenius is creating sustainable value for all stakeholders by executing

  European Sustainability Reporting Standards (ESRS), and is available as a PDF and as an

gene-centric data from 193 web sources, including genomic, transcriptomic, proteomic, genetic,
clinical and functional information.

#                                   Gene & Cell Ltd

#### A London-based, Globally-operating, Consulting Firm for the Gene & Cell Therapies

#### CGT Consultancy

Consultancy services for cell and gene therapies (CGT) play a crucial role in navigating the
complexities of developing and bringing these advanced therapies to market. By leveraging the
expertise of our specialized consultants/collaborators and contractors, companies can enhance their
R&D efforts, ensure regulatory compliance, optimize clinical development, and develop effective
commercial strategies.

Our consultancy services for cell and gene therapies are specialized services aimed at supporting
companies, research institutions, and healthcare providers in the development, regulatory approval,
and commercialization of cell and gene therapies. These services cover a wide range of activities,
including scientific and technical support, regulatory guidance, market analysis, and strategic
consulting.

#### Benefits of our CGT Consulting Services

Expertise: Access to specialized knowledge and experience in a highly complex field.

Efficiency: Streamlined processes and reduced time to market.

Compliance: Ensuring adherence to regulatory standards, minimizing risks of delays or non-approvals.

Innovation: Support for innovative approaches and technologies to stay competitive in the market.

Cost-Effectiveness: Optimizing resources and reducing costs through strategic planning and expert
guidance.



Pricing for cell and gene therapy consultancy can vary widely based on several factors such as the
expertise of the consultant, the scope and complexity of the project, the duration of the
consultancy, and the specific services required.  We are a small, specialized firm focusing solely
on the CGT field and we offer competitive rates with deep industry expertise. We offer highly
competitive hourly rates, project-based rates, retainer agreement fees and specialised services
using specialised expert collaborators/contractors.



Why don't you try us:

The 1st hr of our CGT Consultancy is free! We can learn more about what you need, you can learn more
about what we offer and we could discuss the requirements of your project under either a
confidential (CDA) or a non-confidential framework.





#### What we offer:

* Research and Development (R&D): Assistance with preclinical and clinical research, including
  vector and study design, data analysis, and interpretation.
* Process Development: Optimization of manufacturing processes for cell and gene therapies to ensure
  scalability, efficiency, and compliance with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP).
* Quality Control (QC) and Quality Assurance (QA): Development and implementation of QC/QA systems
  to ensure product quality and consistency.

Regulatory Guidance
* Regulatory Strategy: Development of comprehensive regulatory strategies tailored to different
  markets (e.g., FDA, EMA, PMDA).
* Regulatory Submissions: Preparation and submission of regulatory documents, including
  Investigational New Drug (IND) applications, Biologics License Applications (BLA), and Marketing
  Authorization Applications (MAA).

Compliance: Ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements throughout the product lifecycle.

Clinical Development
* Clinical Trial Design and Management: Designing clinical trial protocols, managing trial
  logistics, and monitoring progress.
* Clinical Data Management: Collection, management, and analysis of clinical trial data.
* Biostatistics: Statistical analysis and support for clinical trials.

Commercial Strategy
* Market Analysis: In-depth analysis of market trends, competitive landscape, and unmet needs.
* Pricing and Reimbursement: Strategies for pricing and securing reimbursement from payers.
* Market Access: Assistance with market access strategies to ensure successful product launch and
  adoption.

Strategic Consulting
* Business Development: Identifying partnership and licensing opportunities, and facilitating

* Project Management: Managing complex projects from inception to completion, ensuring timely
  delivery and alignment with strategic goals.
* Risk Management: Identifying and mitigating risks throughout the product development and
  commercialization process.
* Pitch Decks Design to Investors

critical medicines and the patients and institutions who need them. From named patient supply and
orphan drug sourcing to clinical trial supply and government pharmaceutical programs — we deliver
with regulatory precision, cold chain integrity, and a commitment to access that goes beyond

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

## Celebrating 25 years of saving children’s lives with gene therapy

23 Jul 2026, 11:43 a.m.

Marking 25 years since delivering the first ground-breaking gene therapy here at GOSH, having now
treated more than 135 children with rare and life-threatening conditions across the world.
[ Read more ][99]
[General news][100]
[A man holding a microphone is giving a presentation in front of some equipment]

## A catalyst to unlock the next generation of research leaders

22 Jul 2026, 4:46 p.m.

The NIHR GOSH Biomedical Research Centre (BRC) Fellowships are transforming early-career researchers
into independent leaders - driving innovation, attracting millions in funding and shaping the future
of paediatric science.
[ Read more ][101]
[General news][102]
[A lady in a wheelchair wearing. She is surrounded by six men and women, and a young girl who
wearing a blue top.]

## Landmark decision to screen for spinal muscular atrophy at birth

16 Jul 2026, 3:05 p.m.

Great Ormond Street Hospital (GOSH) is delighted at the announcement that newborn babies in England
will be offered screening for spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) through the newborn blood spot, or "heel
prick", test programme.
[ Read more ][103]
[General news][104]
[A close up image of a vial of liquid with a blurry outline of the man holding it behind]

## From complex science to clear communication

2 Jul 2026, 11:03 a.m.

Across multiple projects at GOSH, patients, families and young people are playing a vital role in
transforming how research is communicated
[ Read more ][105]
[General news][106]
[Lady with brown hair smiling at camera with grey background]

## GOSH welcomes new Chief People Officer

10 Jul 2026, 3 p.m.

Lizzie Smith will join the children’s hospital from NHSE London region
[ Read more ][107]
[General news][108]
[A view from above of adult hands playing with some scientific models and the top of a child's head.
The child has bright white hair and is wearing a lab coat. You can't see their faces]

## Shaping better research from the start

22 Jun 2026, 4:12 p.m.

At GOSH, patient and public involvement is helping researchers to ask the right question, right from
the start.
[ Read more ][109]
[General news][110]

## Celebrating 25 years of saving children’s lives with gene therapy

23 Jul 2026, 11:43 a.m.

Marking 25 years since delivering the first ground-breaking gene therapy here at GOSH, having now
treated more than 135 children with rare and life-threatening conditions across the world.
[ Read more ][99]
[General news][100]
[A man holding a microphone is giving a presentation in front of some equipment]

## A catalyst to unlock the next generation of research leaders

22 Jul 2026, 4:46 p.m.

The NIHR GOSH Biomedical Research Centre (BRC) Fellowships are transforming early-career researchers
into independent leaders - driving innovation, attracting millions in funding and shaping the future
of paediatric science.
[ Read more ][101]
[General news][102]
[A lady in a wheelchair wearing. She is surrounded by six men and women, and a young girl who
wearing a blue top.]

## Landmark decision to screen for spinal muscular atrophy at birth

16 Jul 2026, 3:05 p.m.

Great Ormond Street Hospital (GOSH) is delighted at the announcement that newborn babies in England
will be offered screening for spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) through the newborn blood spot, or "heel
prick", test programme.
[ Read more ][103]
[General news][104]
[A close up image of a vial of liquid with a blurry outline of the man holding it behind]

## From complex science to clear communication

2 Jul 2026, 11:03 a.m.

Across multiple projects at GOSH, patients, families and young people are playing a vital role in
transforming how research is communicated
[ Read more ][105]
[General news][106]
[Lady with brown hair smiling at camera with grey background]

10 Jul 2026, 3 p.m.

[ Read more ][107]

# Home

# ISCT has a vision to translate cell & gene therapies into safe and effective treatments to improve
# patients' lives.

## Thank You FOR JOINING US IN Dublin!

Highlights from ISCT 2026

With packed sessions, global expert speakers, and undeniable enthusiasm across our delegates, it has
been a truly memorable meeting in Dublin. The strength of ISCT is our community - our members,
presenters, delegates, partners, and corporate supporters. We offer our warmest thanks, as together,
we continue to advance the Golden Age of Cell and Gene Therapy.
"...In my opinion, the best conference, and the greatest community."
- Dominic Clarke, PhD, ISCT 2026 Roundtable Co-Chair
With packed sessions, global expert speakers, and undeniable enthusiasm across our delegates, it was
a memorable start to our Dublin meeting.
Day 1 Recap →
"...Once you come to one meeting, you're gonna be hooked. You're gonna come back every year."
- Edwin Horwitz, MD, PhD, Editor-in-Chief of Cytotherapy®
Day Two of ISCT 2026 saw high-energy networking events, strong energy across exhibit and poster
halls, and a truly global selection of high-quality scientific content.
Day 2 Recap →
"We've moved, as an organization, from 'How do we manufacture these products?' to 'How do we get
them in the hands of more patients?'"
- Mark Flower, BSc, ISCT North America Regional Treasurer
Though we wrapped our time in Dublin, the stage is set for our global community to continue driving
momentum across the full translational chain.
Day 3 Recap →

# Home

# ISCT has a vision to translate cell & gene therapies into safe and effective treatments to improve
# patients' lives.

## Thank You FOR JOINING US IN Dublin!

Highlights from ISCT 2026

With packed sessions, global expert speakers, and undeniable enthusiasm across our delegates, it has
been a truly memorable meeting in Dublin. The strength of ISCT is our community - our members,
presenters, delegates, partners, and corporate supporters. We offer our warmest thanks, as together,
we continue to advance the Golden Age of Cell and Gene Therapy.
"...In my opinion, the best conference, and the greatest community."
- Dominic Clarke, PhD, ISCT 2026 Roundtable Co-Chair
With packed sessions, global expert speakers, and undeniable enthusiasm across our delegates, it was
a memorable start to our Dublin meeting.
Day 1 Recap →
"...Once you come to one meeting, you're gonna be hooked. You're gonna come back every year."
- Edwin Horwitz, MD, PhD, Editor-in-Chief of Cytotherapy®
Day Two of ISCT 2026 saw high-energy networking events, strong energy across exhibit and poster
halls, and a truly global selection of high-quality scientific content.
Day 2 Recap →
"We've moved, as an organization, from 'How do we manufacture these products?' to 'How do we get
them in the hands of more patients?'"
- Mark Flower, BSc, ISCT North America Regional Treasurer
Though we wrapped our time in Dublin, the stage is set for our global community to continue driving
momentum across the full translational chain.
Day 3 Recap →

Our process

## Cell Therapy Explained in 5 Steps

Each cell therapy we develop is uniquely designed for each patient, harnessing the power of the
immune system to target and attack cancer. Our CAR T-cell therapy manufacturing process includes
these 5 steps:

STEP 1

### Collect

patient's white
blood cells
STEP 2

### Isolate

and activate
the T cells
STEP 3

### Engineer

the T cells with a chimeric
antigen receptor (CAR) gene
STEP 4

### Grow

and expand the
number of T cells
STEP 5

### Infuse

the same patient with
engineered T cells
[Learn More About Our
Cell Therapy Technology][46]
[Therapy]
Our Therapies

### Singular Focus of Cell Therapy

CAR T-cell therapy is a custom-made, one-time cancer treatment that is designed to work by
engineering a patient’s own white blood cells and harnessing their immune system to treat certain
kinds of blood cancer.

[Discover Our Therapies ][47]
our pipeline

### Pushing Forward

Our broad and diversified pipeline includes research to discover novel ways to improve patients’
responses to cell therapy, different cell therapy modalities, and ways to increase the speed of our
manufacturing efforts.

# GMP Manufacturing Services For Clinical Trials

Services offered by the facilities include:
* The aseptic manufacturing of large and small volume liquids
* The non-sterile manufacturing of a range of dosage forms
* Ambient, refrigerated and frozen storage
* Label design (adheres to Annex 13), printing and application
* Primary and secondary packaging, including blinding of IMP
* Fully trained staff
* Distribution to clinical trial sites
* GMP QC
* Product certification and release by a QP
* Current EU GMP standards
* Home Office licence to order, store supply and possess as part of a clinical trial
* MHRA MIA (IMP) licence

##### PRODUCTS

 

The types of products that we may work with include:

 

Capsules, liquids, tablets and other dosage forms for use in:
* The gastro-intestinal system
* The cardiovascular system
* The respiratory system

...

Sterile production is undertaken in the accredited aseptic manufacturing suite operating at a range
of environments up to grade ‘B’ EU GMP standards. The unit operates two Envair CDC-‘F’ grade ‘A’
negatively pressured isolators with

...

[Read More][11]

##### NON-STERILE WORK

The facility has the following equipment available for use in non-sterile production in an EU GMP
standard grade ‘C’ environment:
* Atlas Clean Air biosafety laminar flow cabinet
* Balances of up to 5 decimal places

...

[Read More][12]

###### PHARMACEUTICAL EXCELLENCE

### DELIVERING FOR YOU

### ABOUT US

## The GMP Manufacturing Facility For Clinical Trials

MAC focuses on manufacturing medications for Phase 1 through phase 3 studies. We support both
independent research centres and the NHS in conducting clinical trials. MAC Clinical Research is the
UK's largest neuroscience research company dedicated to the recruitment and management of clinical
trials. MAC currently has eight dedicated research centres across the UK conducting trials from
complex early phase all the way to Phase IV studies for a wide range of therapeutic areas.

[Read More][13]

MAC's GMP-compliant facility is located in Leeds and we have additional aseptic facilities in

## 事業内容
## BUSINESS

### 特定細胞加工物製造業

再生医療等安全性確保法に基づく特定細胞加工物の製造を受託します。

[詳しく見る][85]

### CDMO事業

医薬品医療機器等法（薬機法）に基づく再生医療等製品・治験製品の工程開発から製造受託までトータルサポー
トで承ります。

[詳しく見る][86]

### バリューチェーン事業

再生医療の細胞加工に携わるすべてのお客様の業務負荷を軽減するためのソリューションを提供し、円滑な再生
医療の実施を支援いたします。

[詳しく見る][87]

### 自己がん組織バンク

将来のがん治療に備えて、がんの手術などで摘出した患者さんのがん組織を無償でお預かりします。

[詳しく見る][88]

### 免疫細胞治療とは

免疫細胞治療は、自分の免疫細胞を使ってがんを攻撃する治療法です。メディネットは創業以来、免疫細胞治療
の技術開発に取り組んでいます。

[詳しく見る][89]

## 事業内容
## BUSINESS

### 特定細胞加工物製造業

再生医療等安全性確保法に基づく特定細胞加工物の製造を受託します。

[詳しく見る][85]

### CDMO事業

医薬品医療機器等法（薬機法）に基づく再生医療等製品・治験製品の工程開発から製造受託までトータルサポー
トで承ります。

[詳しく見る][86]

### バリューチェーン事業

再生医療の細胞加工に携わるすべてのお客様の業務負荷を軽減するためのソリューションを提供し、円滑な再生
医療の実施を支援いたします。

[詳しく見る][87]

### 自己がん組織バンク

将来のがん治療に備えて、がんの手術などで摘出した患者さんのがん組織を無償でお預かりします。

[詳しく見る][88]

### 免疫細胞治療とは

免疫細胞治療は、自分の免疫細胞を使ってがんを攻撃する治療法です。メディネットは創業以来、免疫細胞治療
の技術開発に取り組んでいます。

[詳しく見る][89]

Biologics & CGT Testing

## Minaris Advanced Testing

Standalone or integrated GMP testing across all biologics modalities, performed in our dedicated
140,000 ft² Philadelphia facility. With over 40 years of experience, we support cell therapies,
viral vectors, monoclonal antibodies, recombinant proteins, and vaccines with rapid,
regulator-accepted results.

Need standalone or integrated testing?

[ Explore Testing Services ][81]
* Analytical Development
  
  Our analytical scientists design, optimize and validate assays across the full lifecycle, from
  early-phase methods to commercial readiness. Services include potency, purity, identity and
  stability testing, aligned with ICH Q2 and global regulatory expectations. Integrated with
  development and manufacturing, we ensure reliable GMP performance across all modalities.
  
  [ Learn About Analytical Development ][82]
  1 / 8
* Assay Transfer
  
  Smooth assay transfer ensures continuity and reliability across sites and studies, maintaining
  consistency and accuracy. We deliver structured, data-driven transfers, including gap analysis,
  bridging studies and qualification/validation, in accordance with ICH Q2. Methods are supported
  across viral vectors, gene-edited cells, monoclonal antibodies (mAbs), proteins and vaccines,
  ensuring seamless readiness for lot release, stability and comparability studies.
  
  [ See Assay Transfer Support ][83]
  2 / 8
* Biosafety Testing
  
  With more than 40 years of biosafety expertise, Minaris provides GMP-compliant sterility,
  mycoplasma, endotoxin, adventitious agent and replication-competent virus testing. Our specialized
  focus on CGT ensures risk-based strategies tailored to viral vectors, plasmids and packaging
  systems. Results are audit-ready and regulator-accepted, supporting IND, IMPD and BLA submissions
  worldwide.
  
  [ Explore Biosafety Testing ][84]
  3 / 8
* Cell Line Characterization
  
  We provide comprehensive, regulatory-compliant characterization of Master, Working and
  End-of-Production Cell Banks, including sterility, mycoplasma, endotoxin, retroviral and identity
  testing. Our services align with the guidelines of the ICH, FDA, EMA and PMDA, enabling the faster
  release of GMP cell banks and seamless integration into development and manufacturing workflows.
  
  [ Learn About Cell Line Characterization ][85]
  4 / 8
* Lot Release
  
  A reliable lot release ensures that therapies reach patients without delay. Minaris provides a
  comprehensive GMP testing panel across various modalities, including sterility, identity, potency,
  purity, residuals, RCL/rcAAV and more. With thousands of batches tested, our validated assays
  support global submissions and commercial approvals, minimizing risk and accelerating patient
  access.
  
  [ See Lot Release ][86]
  5 / 8
* Potency
  
  Potency is a critical quality attribute. We design and validate custom assays, ranging from
  cell-based functional studies and reporter gene assays to ELISA, PCR and transduction efficiency
  tests. All assays meet ICH Q2 standards, providing meaningful biological insights that satisfy
  regulators and support product release and lifecycle management.
  
  [ Explore Potency ][87]
  6 / 8
* Stability
  
  We deliver ICH Q1-compliant stability programs, including long-term, real-time, accelerated and
  ongoing studies. Our methods support all biologic and advanced therapy modalities, with
  submission-ready data for global regulators. By evaluating shelf life and storage conditions, we
  ensure that therapies maintain their safety, quality and efficacy throughout distribution and
  patient use.
  
  [ Learn About Stability ][88]
  7 / 8
* Viral Clearance
  
  A global leader with 3,000+ studies and zero regulatory rejections, Minaris designs viral
  clearance studies aligned with ICH Q5A(R2), FDA, EMA and WHO guidelines. Dedicated viral clearance
  suites with AKTA systems ensure rigorous validation across vectors, proteins and vaccines,
  safeguarding patient safety and accelerating regulatory approvals.
  
  [ See Viral Clearance ][89]
  8 / 8

Biologics & CGT Testing

## Minaris Advanced Testing

Standalone or integrated GMP testing across all biologics modalities, performed in our dedicated
140,000 ft² Philadelphia facility. With over 40 years of experience, we support cell therapies,
viral vectors, monoclonal antibodies, recombinant proteins, and vaccines with rapid,
regulator-accepted results.

Need standalone or integrated testing?

[ Explore Testing Services ][81]
* Analytical Development
  
  Our analytical scientists design, optimize and validate assays across the full lifecycle, from
  early-phase methods to commercial readiness. Services include potency, purity, identity and
  stability testing, aligned with ICH Q2 and global regulatory expectations. Integrated with
  development and manufacturing, we ensure reliable GMP performance across all modalities.
  
  [ Learn About Analytical Development ][82]
  1 / 8
* Assay Transfer
  
  Smooth assay transfer ensures continuity and reliability across sites and studies, maintaining
  consistency and accuracy. We deliver structured, data-driven transfers, including gap analysis,
  bridging studies and qualification/validation, in accordance with ICH Q2. Methods are supported
  across viral vectors, gene-edited cells, monoclonal antibodies (mAbs), proteins and vaccines,
  ensuring seamless readiness for lot release, stability and comparability studies.
  
  [ See Assay Transfer Support ][83]
  2 / 8
* Biosafety Testing
  
  With more than 40 years of biosafety expertise, Minaris provides GMP-compliant sterility,
  mycoplasma, endotoxin, adventitious agent and replication-competent virus testing. Our specialized
  focus on CGT ensures risk-based strategies tailored to viral vectors, plasmids and packaging
  systems. Results are audit-ready and regulator-accepted, supporting IND, IMPD and BLA submissions
  worldwide.
  
  [ Explore Biosafety Testing ][84]
  3 / 8
* Cell Line Characterization
  
  We provide comprehensive, regulatory-compliant characterization of Master, Working and
  End-of-Production Cell Banks, including sterility, mycoplasma, endotoxin, retroviral and identity
  testing. Our services align with the guidelines of the ICH, FDA, EMA and PMDA, enabling the faster
  release of GMP cell banks and seamless integration into development and manufacturing workflows.
  
  [ Learn About Cell Line Characterization ][85]
  4 / 8
* Lot Release
  
  A reliable lot release ensures that therapies reach patients without delay. Minaris provides a
  comprehensive GMP testing panel across various modalities, including sterility, identity, potency,
  purity, residuals, RCL/rcAAV and more. With thousands of batches tested, our validated assays
  support global submissions and commercial approvals, minimizing risk and accelerating patient
  access.
  
  [ See Lot Release ][86]
  5 / 8
* Potency
  
  Potency is a critical quality attribute. We design and validate custom assays, ranging from
  cell-based functional studies and reporter gene assays to ELISA, PCR and transduction efficiency
  tests. All assays meet ICH Q2 standards, providing meaningful biological insights that satisfy
  regulators and support product release and lifecycle management.
  
  [ Explore Potency ][87]
  6 / 8
* Stability
  
  We deliver ICH Q1-compliant stability programs, including long-term, real-time, accelerated and
  ongoing studies. Our methods support all biologic and advanced therapy modalities, with
  submission-ready data for global regulators. By evaluating shelf life and storage conditions, we
  ensure that therapies maintain their safety, quality and efficacy throughout distribution and
  patient use.
  
  [ Learn About Stability ][88]
  7 / 8
* Viral Clearance
  
  A global leader with 3,000+ studies and zero regulatory rejections, Minaris designs viral
  clearance studies aligned with ICH Q5A(R2), FDA, EMA and WHO guidelines. Dedicated viral clearance
  suites with AKTA systems ensure rigorous validation across vectors, proteins and vaccines,
  safeguarding patient safety and accelerating regulatory approvals.
  
  [ See Viral Clearance ][89]
  8 / 8

# Manufacturing Excellence for Transformative Therapies

## Your Lifelong Cell and Gene Therapy CDMO Partner

[ Explore Our Services ][68]

## Bringing Your Cell and Gene Therapy to Life

Selecting a cell and gene therapy contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) partner
is critical. At OmniaBio, we revolutionize cell and gene therapy manufacturing to enhance the
affordability and accessibility of treatments. With decades of collective experience in both
autologous and allogeneic cell therapies, we navigate the complexities of process development and
GMP manufacturing to advance your program efficiently.

Our dedication to innovation and collaboration ensures that we are not just a CGT CDMO, but a true
innovation partner in bringing your groundbreaking therapies to life for patients in need.

[ Request A Consult ][69]
[commercial-capacity-logo]
Early development to commercial capacity
[flex-scalable-updated]
Flexible, scalable technology solutions
[ai-manufacturing-icon]
AI-enabled development and GMP manufacturing

## Seamless Transition from Early Development to Commercial Supply

Our expertise in advanced manufacturing services ensures the reliable execution needed to propel
your program forward. Our comprehensive suite of services seamlessly merges technical proficiency in
cell-based processes and gene delivery tools with cutting-edge advancements in process development
and manufacturing. This integration provides holistic capabilities that span the entire product
lifecycle – from preclinical development to large-scale commercial manufacturing.
With a variety of GMP suite options (Grade B or Grade C), we deliver GMP manufacturing of cell
therapies that comply with U.S., Canadian, and European regulations. Trust us to guide your journey
toward compliant, scalable, and cost-effective manufacturing.

## Advancing Autologous Cell Therapies with Robust, Scalable Solutions

With over a decade of experience developing immune cell-based therapy processes, our team of
technical experts specializes in developing and optimizing manufacturing platforms. We integrate
closed-unit systems, AI models, and robotics to create robust, scalable, and efficient processes
tailored to your needs.

#### Process Development

Process development and optimization expertise for enhanced robustness and reliable scale-up.
[ Explore Process Development ][70]

#### Analytical Development

Comprehensive analytical development services for tailored and established assays.
[ EXPLORE ANALYTICAL DEVELOPMENT ][71]

#### Autologous Manufacturing

Hamilton Intelligent Facility: AI and robotics integration for enhanced production rates and reduced
costs.
[ EXPLORE AUTOLOGOUS MANUFACTURING ][72]

#### Platform Expertise

Cutting-edge cell platforms for lentiviral vector-, immune cell- and iPSC-based therapies.
[ EXPLORE OUR PLATFORMS ][73]

#### GMP Manufacturing

Resilient manufacturing for consistent quality, certified compliance, and minimal risks at every
stage.
[ EXPLORE GMP MANUFACTURING ][74]

#### Commercial Manufacturing

Efficient scalability, timely QC release, and reliable delivery to support your commercial goals.
[ EXPLORE COMMERCIAL MANUFACTURING ][75]

## Personalized Client Services for Your Program's Success

As your reliable cell and gene therapy CDMO partner, we focus on reducing risk and amplifying
assurance so that you can confidently move your program forward, knowing that it is in capable
hands. Our teams ensure you receive the highest level of services, transparency, and collaboration.
With CMC program requirements ranging in complexity and project type, our collaborative approach
follows a standardized process customized for your needs, driving your success.
1. Seamless client onboarding with a dedicated project manager
2. Clear communication and documentation designed to meet your needs
3. Frequent project meetings and milestone tracking
4. Close to real-time data sharing

## What’s New

OmniaBio opens Canada’s largest CGT manufacturing facility in Hamilton, Ontario, integrating AI,
automation, and advanced technologies to enhance cell and gene therapy production. As a global CDMO,

accessibility, and advancements in regenerative medicine across North America and beyond.

# Manufacturing Excellence for Transformative Therapies

## Your Lifelong Cell and Gene Therapy CDMO Partner

[ Explore Our Services ][68]

## Bringing Your Cell and Gene Therapy to Life

Selecting a cell and gene therapy contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) partner
is critical. At OmniaBio, we revolutionize cell and gene therapy manufacturing to enhance the
affordability and accessibility of treatments. With decades of collective experience in both
autologous and allogeneic cell therapies, we navigate the complexities of process development and
GMP manufacturing to advance your program efficiently.

Our dedication to innovation and collaboration ensures that we are not just a CGT CDMO, but a true
innovation partner in bringing your groundbreaking therapies to life for patients in need.

[ Request A Consult ][69]

[flex-scalable-updated]

[ai-manufacturing-icon]
AI-enabled development and GMP manufacturing

## Seamless Transition from Early Development to Commercial Supply

Our expertise in advanced manufacturing services ensures the reliable execution needed to propel
your program forward. Our comprehensive suite of services seamlessly merges technical proficiency in
cell-based processes and gene delivery tools with cutting-edge advancements in process development
and manufacturing. This integration provides holistic capabilities that span the entire product
lifecycle – from preclinical development to large-scale commercial manufacturing.
With a variety of GMP suite options (Grade B or Grade C), we deliver GMP manufacturing of cell
therapies that comply with U.S., Canadian, and European regulations. Trust us to guide your journey
toward compliant, scalable, and cost-effective manufacturing.

## Advancing Autologous Cell Therapies with Robust, Scalable Solutions

With over a decade of experience developing immune cell-based therapy processes, our team of
technical experts specializes in developing and optimizing manufacturing platforms. We integrate
closed-unit systems, AI models, and robotics to create robust, scalable, and efficient processes
tailored to your needs.

#### Process Development

Process development and optimization expertise for enhanced robustness and reliable scale-up.

#### Analytical Development

Comprehensive analytical development services for tailored and established assays.

#### Autologous Manufacturing

Hamilton Intelligent Facility: AI and robotics integration for enhanced production rates and reduced
costs.

Cutting-edge cell platforms for lentiviral vector-, immune cell- and iPSC-based therapies.

Resilient manufacturing for consistent quality, certified compliance, and minimal risks at every

[ EXPLORE GMP MANUFACTURING ][74]

#### Commercial Manufacturing

Efficient scalability, timely QC release, and reliable delivery to support your commercial goals.

## Personalized Client Services for Your Program's Success

### Focused Manufacturing from Preclinical to Commercial Scale

As your reliable cell and gene therapy CDMO partner, we focus on reducing risk and amplifying
assurance so that you can confidently move your program forward, knowing that it is in capable
hands. Our teams ensure you receive the highest level of services, transparency, and collaboration.
With CMC program requirements ranging in complexity and project type, our collaborative approach
follows a standardized process customized for your needs, driving your success.
1. Seamless client onboarding with a dedicated project manager
2. Clear communication and documentation designed to meet your needs
3. Frequent project meetings and milestone tracking
4. Close to real-time data sharing
[ More About Our Facilities ][76]

## What’s New

OmniaBio opens Canada’s largest CGT manufacturing facility in Hamilton, Ontario, integrating AI,
automation, and advanced technologies to enhance cell and gene therapy production. As a global CDMO,
we partner with biotech innovators to deliver transformative therapies, driving affordability,
accessibility, and advancements in regenerative medicine across North America and beyond.

**Supporting the Cell and Gene Therapy Industry to get treatments to patients faster**

We are driven by a single mission: to transform patient outcomes by building the connections that
power life-changing treatments. 

At Phacilitate, we don’t just bring people together, we create exceptional, high-impact experiences
through year-round knowledge sharing, events, and thriving micro-communities. 

We believe true innovation happens when collaboration takes center stage. The whole is greater than
the sum of its parts, and by fostering powerful partnerships and open knowledge exchange, we help
accelerate therapies from breakthrough to patient, where they matter most.

### Connecting the Global Advanced Therapies Community to Accelerate Patient Access

For 24 years, Phacilitate has united the global advanced therapies ecosystem to accelerate the
development and delivery of life-changing cell and gene therapies. Through strategic events,
partnerships, and insights, we support biotech companies at every stage of their commercialization

## Have a Question?


### Who are Phacilitate?

Phacilitate is a global platform serving the advanced therapies industry through events, content,
research, networking and industry intelligence. We connect the people responsible for developing,
manufacturing, funding, regulating and commercialising cell and gene therapies.

### What industries does Phacilitate serve?

Phacilitate serves professionals across the advanced therapies ecosystem, including biotechnology
companies, pharmaceutical organisations, investors, academics, regulators, healthcare providers,
manufacturers, technology providers and patient-focused organisations.

### What topics in gene therapy are covered at these events?

Across all three events, gene therapy is a core focus. Sessions span clinical trials, molecular
therapy innovations, CRISPR-based therapy, CAR T therapy, and the evolving regulatory landscape for
gene therapies. You’ll also explore key themes such as patient access, platform scalability, and
approaches to gene therapy research.

### Where and when are the upcoming events?

[Advanced Therapies Europe][28] - September 7-9, 2026 in Barcelona, Spain 

[Advanced Therapies World][29] - December 5-6, 2026 in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia 

[Advanced Therapies Week][30] - January 18-21, 2027 in San Diego, USA 

### Who will I meet if I attend?

You’ll connect with global leaders across the cell and gene therapy ecosystem, including therapeutic
developers, regulators, investors, CROs, CDMOs, academics, and patient advocates. Whether you’re
seeking strategic partnerships or clinical collaborators, these events bring the right people
together.

### What kind of speakers can I expect?

Expect to hear from CEOs of pioneering biotech companies, clinical leaders, regulators from the FDA
and EMA, and research scientists shaping the future of gene therapy. Many are directly involved in
recent gene therapy approvals or are breaking ground in next-gen platforms and clinical
applications.

### Are there exhibitors relevant to gene therapy?

Yes, the show floor features companies specialising in clinical pharmacology, gene delivery
technologies, manufacturing solutions, and platform innovation. You’ll find partners for every stage
of your therapy’s development, from discovery through to commercialisation.

### How are the sessions structured for people working specifically in gene therapy?

Our events offer focused tracks and roundtables built around key gene & cell therapy themes. Whether
you’re looking to overcome delivery challenges, navigate regulatory hurdles, or engage with patients
more effectively, you’ll find actionable insights grounded in real-world data and experience.

### Are these events suitable for early-stage biotech companies?

Absolutely. Dedicated programming supports emerging companies — from sessions on trial readiness and
scale-up, to investor showcases and access to industry mentors. You’ll gain practical knowledge and
meet people who understand the challenges of bringing a gene therapy to market.

### Will there be opportunities to discuss patient engagement?

Yes. Sessions include direct input from patient advocates, covering topics such as ethical trial
design, informed consent, and real-world barriers to patient access. These perspectives are critical
to ensuring that the therapies we develop are meaningful and accessible.

### Do the events support professional development?

Yes. Events such as Advanced Therapies Europe offer CPD accreditation, supporting your continued
growth in areas like clinical research, regulatory strategy, and innovation in gene therapy.

### What are advanced therapies?

Advanced therapies are a group of innovative treatments that include cell therapies, gene therapies,
regenerative medicine and tissue-engineered products. These therapies aim to address diseases at
their source and have the potential to transform patient outcomes across oncology, rare disease,
autoimmune conditions and many other therapeutic areas.

### What are the biggest challenges facing the advanced therapies industry?

The industry faces a range of challenges, including clinical development, manufacturing scale-up,
regulatory alignment, investment, reimbursement, patient access and commercialisation. Solving these
challenges requires collaboration across the entire ecosystem.

### How does Phacilitate support the advanced therapies community?

Phacilitate supports the industry through global events, expert-led content, market insights,
thought leadership, networking opportunities and industry partnerships designed to help
organisations solve challenges and accelerate progress.

### Where can I learn about cell and gene therapy industry trends?

Phacilitate publishes industry content, expert interviews, research, event insights and thought
leadership covering topics such as clinical development, manufacturing, regulation, investment,
market access and emerging technologies in advanced therapies.

### What topics does Phacilitate cover?

Phacilitate covers the full advanced therapies lifecycle, including cell therapy, gene therapy,
regenerative medicine, clinical development, manufacturing, automation, regulation, investment,
commercialisation, reimbursement, patient access and emerging technologies.

### How do advanced therapy companies find investors, partners and service providers?

Many organisations build relationships through industry networks, events, strategic partnerships and
thought leadership communities. Phacilitate helps facilitate these connections by bringing together
stakeholders from across the advanced therapies ecosystem.

### What is the future of cell and gene therapy?

The future of cell and gene therapy is expected to be shaped by advances in manufacturing,
automation, gene editing, AI-enabled development, regulatory innovation and new commercial models
that improve patient access to transformative treatments.

### How are Phacilitate meetings different from traditional conferences?

Phacilitate meetings are designed to help advanced therapies professionals build meaningful
connections and solve real business challenges. Rather than focusing solely on presentations, our
events combine curated networking, facilitated introductions, interactive discussions and expert-led
content to connect the people developing, manufacturing, funding, regulating and commercialising
advanced therapies.

### How does networking work at Phacilitate events?

Phacilitate combines technology, curated introductions and facilitated networking to help attendees
meet the people most relevant to their goals. Whether you're seeking investment, manufacturing
partners, collaborators, customers or industry insight, our events are designed to make meaningful
conversations easier to start and more valuable to continue.

### How do I register or buy a ticket?

This depends on which event you wish to attend. Simply, select the event or meeting you want to
attend from the main website menu and you’ll find full details about tickets, pricing, and what’s
included.

### What should I do before I arrive?

Look at the agenda, set up your partnering profile, and plan any meetings in advance. If you’re
speaking or exhibiting, make sure your profile is filled in so people can find you.

### Can I promote my company at the event?

Yes. You can book a stand, sponsor a session, join the speaker line-up, or get listed in the Cell
and Gene Directory. It’s a great way to get in front of decision-makers. If you're interested in
learning more, simply visit the main website page for the event/meeting you wish to attend, and
navigate to the sponsorship tab from there. 

### How do I stay informed about programme updates and releases?

Use the sign up option on the home page to receive regular updates, which is positioned as the route
to the latest news, programme updates, and releases. If you are coordinating attendance across a
team, it can also help to subscribe early so you do not miss key milestones.

 

## Phacilitate’s Next Global Meeting:

**Advanced Therapies Europe 2026**

Join the industry in** Barcelona | 7 - 9 September 2026 **for 3 days of deal-making, data-driven
insight and serious momentum across cell and gene therapy. From early science to commercial scale,
this is where the full ecosystem connects, collaborates and moves the field forward. 

[Register for ATE 2026 now →][31]

# Life-changing therapies
# without a lifetime of
# development

Precision for Medicine solves the most complex clinical development challenges to bring innovative
therapies to patients. [ Contact Us ][153]

No one who is working to help patients in need should be subjected to unnecessary delays during
clinical development and commercialization. Precision’s integrated capabilities, responsive
operations and deep scientific expertise are helping life science innovators accelerate research and
development while reducing cost and increasing the probability of approval.

## Specialized capabilities for every stage of clinical development

Leverage an integrated infrastructure that reduces the inefficiencies inherent in complex
development. Integrate lab and trial execution to increase speed to market. Precision brings a
holistic view to your program's unique needs.

## The approved treatment for big five CRO Fatigue

Precision is a right-sized CRO and the antidote to the widespread exhaustion that can come from
dealing with a big five CRO. We specialize in the unique needs of complex trials. Our people are
assigned to no more than 2 or 3 trials at a time, so you get the attention you need, when you need
it. Find out more about how Precision beats Big Five Fatigue.

* [ AVOID THESE SYMPTOMS ][160]

  ### Optimize early phase development
  
  How can you successfully navigate the complexities of early phase development? Integrated clinical
  and laboratory sciences capabilities are vital. Over 25 years of experience in early oncology
  development helps anticipate and mitigate a diverse set of risks, including complicated kitting
  and sample management.
  
  Discover
* [Discover Maximize late phase development][162]
  [Maximize late phase development]
  
  ### Maximize late phase development
  
  Congratulations if you are entering late phase development. Now you’ll need a partner that can
  recruit patients most likely to respond to treatment, manage complex protocols, anticipate global
  regulatory requirements, enable manufacturing, support commercial viability and more. Let us drive
  your innovation to market and empower access for patients.
  
  Discover
[human-]

## Trusted partner to leading innovators in oncology and rare disease

Clinical development is growing more complicated. Progress can hinge on the ability to navigate a
shifting pathway to approval. Your path may be unique from those who have gone before, but our
experience will help inform success. Precision is a leader in oncology and rare disease research.
Our deep experience in complex indications accelerates the ability to reach key milestones, drive
positive outcomes and most importantly, help patients get access to innovative treatme

We are living in the most exciting time in human history. The future is probably cooler than
anything we can imagine. Our goal is to get there, together. 

Don’t Die,Bryan Johnson
Planet Earth, 2026
